30. The best day ever?

Summary for the Chapter:

Someone has been trying to find Lena for awhile. They show up on a seemingly normal morning at the Luthor-Danvers residence. What will happen? Who will it be?

Notes for the Chapter:

Hi everyone! Here's a little twist in the plot for you all!

Mistakes are my own, happy reading!

December 1st, 2027 

 

Lily - 7 years old 

Alexis - 7 months old 

 

Alex slid a piece of paper across the counter to Kara. “What’s this?” She asked while putting a spoonful of cereal into her mouth. It looked like a report of some kind.

 

“Someone’s looking for Lena. Or at least that’s what we think. There has been a spike in searches for her lately, that’s not normal.”

 

Kara put her empty bowl in the sink, “Could it be like... science research stuff?” 

 

Alex shook her head, “Someone’s been searching for info on her personal life. Job history, address, phone number. Brainy scattered the info and covered it up but I wanted you to be aware it was going on.”

 

“Do we need to worry?” 

 

“Maggie doesn’t think so. They’re from all over the world so it’s not like it’s one secluded IP address. We’ll keep an eye on it and let you know though.” 

 

Kara nodded, “Alright. Thank you.”

 

“Of course Kar, we love you guys.” 

 

“We love you guys too. Now hand me the baby and nobody gets hurt,” she teased, holding her arms out for her niece. 

 

Alex rolled her eyes with a laugh but handed her daughter over. “You know there’s no competition for favorite aunt, right?” 

 

“I know,” Kara said, cradling her niece close. “And if there was… I would win. I can fly, Lena can’t.” 

 

Alex laughed, “As if your head needs to be any bigger. We already named her after you.” 

 

“As you should,” Kara teased. “You’ve got a pretty special name, little one. Being named after your grandpa and your favorite aunt. Maya El Danvers-Sawyer. You are gonna be so spoiled rotten when you grow up.” 

 

“You guys already spoil her. She needs nothing else. Possibly ever.” 

 

“Your momma lies, don’t listen to her Maya. Aunt Lena and I will make sure you always have the coolest stuff.” 

 

Alex leaned against her, shoulder to shoulder, “All she needs is to be loved.” 

 

Kara pressed a kiss to Alex’s cheek. “You don’t have to worry about that. We all know she’s gonna be smothered at home, grandma’s, and here. She’s gonna have cousin sleepovers, movie nights, family vacations. She’s never going to know what it’s like to lose a parent because you and Maggie will always be there. She’ll never have to worry about being alone, because she’s going to be so surrounded by people who love her, that it’ll annoy her eventually.” 

 

Alex snorted out a laugh, “You’re right. Just like your girls will never want for anything. They’ll be so smothered in love it’s crazy.” 

 

“Oh I know. You should see the morning cuddles we get with the girls. I can’t imagine if we’d done that with Eliza.” 

 

“Yea we never would have done that.” 

 

“I might have with my jeju when I was little. But… not when I got older. I don’t want them to grow up ever. I just want them to stay this little forever,” she said, running her finger down her niece’s nose. 

 

“I agree. They’re so cute and amazing when they’re this little.” 

 

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

 

A few hours later the girls were fast asleep upstairs as they were cleaning up for the day. Kara rinsed off their plates from dinner before sliding them into the dishwasher racks. Lena was putting their leftovers into the fridge. “Alex came over earlier with Maya.” 

 

“Oh? How are they doing?” 

 

“Good. It wasn’t just a social visit. I guess someone’s been looking into you. Brainy took care of it but she wanted us to be aware it was happening.” 

 

Lena closed the refrigerator door and turned to look at her properly, “What do you mean?” 

 

“She said someone has been looking into your previous jobs, phone numbers, addresses. But Brainy has stopped them from finding anything.” 

 

Lena frowned, “That’s… odd. Maybe I’ll do some digging of my own, see what I can find.” 

 

“Alright, but don’t stress out about it. The DEO will handle it. And if something was to happen, I’d protect you.” 

 

“I know darling. But I don’t want anyone hurting the girls trying to get to me.” 

 

Kara hummed in agreement as she closed the dishwasher and turned it on. “Well there’s nothing we can do tonight about it.” 

 

“Fine. I’ll look into it tomorrow. Let’s go to bed, it was a long day.” 

 

“I second that.” 

 

February 1st, 2028

 

Lily - 7 years old 

Alexis - 11 months 

 

It was a normal day. Kara woke up to the sound of a door creaking open. She opened her eyes and saw one of the cutest sights. Lily’s head was peeking around the door and Alexis’s little face was about two feet below hers. Kara couldn’t help but smile. “Come snuggle,” she whispered. 

 

The door was pushed open and Lily helped her little sister toddle over to the bed. Kara reached down to lift Alexis onto the bed. Lily climbed up and stepped over her, to snuggle into Lena. It only took seconds for her wife’s arm to wrap around their daughter and hold her close. Alexis pushed her face into the gap between Kara’s neck and shoulder. She ran her fingers up and down her daughters back lightly. 

 

“Mama,” Alexis said sleepily. Kara smiled while pressing a soft kiss to her head. Lena smiled over at them while covering Lily up with their blankets. Little huffs of air against her neck signaled that they might be able to get another hour or so of sleep. Her own eyelids closed as she breathed in the familiar scent of her baby girl. 

 

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

 

An hour later found the four of them sharing sleepy stories in bed. Alexis was sitting up on Kara’s stomach while Lily was snuggled between both her moms. “You girls were up early today. What had you two up?” 

 

Lily yawned, “The sun was up, and so were we.” 

 

Kara laughed along with Lena. “Alright. Well why don’t we go start breakfast? We can do something fun today.” She scooped up Alexis while LIly hopped off the bed and padded downstairs. Lena climbed out of bed with a stretch and then held out her arms for Alexis. Kara handed her over and watched her daughter snuggle into her wife’s neck. Her hair was coming in darker than Kara and Lily’s, but not as dark as Lena’s. Her eyes were a beautiful emerald just like Lena’s though. 

 

The trio made their way downstairs to where Lily was already pulling out the box of pancake mix. “Can we do chocolate chips today?” 

 

Lena started the coffee maker while answering her, “Only if we cut up fruit too. You girls can’t just have sugar for breakfast.” 

 

“Deal,” Lily said. Kara took out a packet of strawberries, blueberries, and an apple. She dumped them all into a colander and ran them under the running faucet. Lena settled Alexis into her high chair when there was a knock at the door. 

 

“I’ve got it babe. You start the pancakes,” Kara said, pressing a kiss to Lena’s cheek. 

 

“Alright darling.” 

 

Kara crossed their living room to the front door and opened it. An older woman was standing on the porch wringing her hands together. “Hi, can I help you?” 

 

“I’m looking for Lena Luthor.” 

 

Kara was immediately suspicious, “I’m sorry I can’t help you with that. She doesn’t live here.” 

 

“Please, do you know where I can find her?” 

 

“I’m sorry I don’t know you.” 

 

“My name is Kieran Daley. I’ve been looking everywhere for her for years.” 

 

Kara felt her heart stutter in her chest, “Did you say Kieran?” Immediately she started to really take in the woman. She had dark wavy hair, striking green eyes, and her voice had a distinct irish accent to it the more she talked. 

 

“I did. Please, you have to help me. She’s my daughter.” 

 

It shouldn’t be possible. Surely Lena would have looked into her birth mother after crisis… but what if she hadn’t? Kara felt her heart start to hammer in her chest. They had a promise that they would protect their girls no matter what. Letting a woman into their home who claimed to be Lena’s long lost dead mother… it didn’t seem plausible.

 

“I have a lot of questions… starting with, what led you to this address? This is a private residence.” 

 

The woman seemed to relax just a hair, “I’ve been looking for her for years. I’ve hired a few private investigators that have been tracking her down. She’s a hard woman to find.” 

 

Kara crossed her arms over her chest, “Well privacy and safety is important, especially to someone of her status.” 

 

“I couldn’t agree more with you. I will answer any questions you want. I’ve come a long way and I’ve been waiting so long to see her. Can I please talk to her?” 

 

“As you just agreed with me, safety is important. You’ll have to forgive me but I can’t just let you into my home.” 

 

The woman nodded with a sad look on her face, “I understand. It’s just been so long since I’ve seen her.” Green eyes drifted away from hers and moved somewhere off to Kara’s side. 

 

Lily appeared and tugged on Kara’s hand, “Mummy said to tell you breakfast is ready.” 

 

Kara put a hand on the back of her head lightly, “Alright honey. I’ll be right there.” 

 

Lily eyed the lady for a minute but went back into the other room. The woman, Kieran, looked at her longingly. “Surely you understand, I just want a few minutes to see my daughter. Please, I’m begging you.” 

 

Kara ran a hand through her hair. “I do understand, but you also have to understand, so many people have tried to hurt her. Tried to take her life. Her own brother tried on multiple occasions.” She quickly fired off a message to Alex asking her to locate and verify who Kieran Daley was. Alex messaged back quickly giving her a thumbs up. 

 

“Darling, who’s at the door?” Lena’s voice rang out from the kitchen. Kara heard her rounding the corner, and the moment her breath caught. 

 

“Lena?” The woman all but whispered, both women’s hearts were racing. 

 

Lena took a cautious step forward and gripped Kara’s arm. “Mum…?” 

 

“I’ve been searching for you for so long.” 

 

“Kar… how... ?” 

 

Kara slipped her hand down to lace their fingers together. “I honestly don’t know. Maybe the crisis seven years ago?”

 

Lena nodded, her eyes never leaving the woman in front of them. “I don’t know what to say… I thought you died.” 

“That’s what they wanted you to think mo g r á. I’ve been looking for you since you turned 18. I followed everything you did with L-Corp. I was trying to find ways to get in contact with you but I kept running into problems. When I got to the US I had the unfortunate chance to meet Lillian. She threatened to hurt you if I didn’t stay away. So I went home and let you be. I wanted you to live your life and be happy. But then things started happening with your brother. People were attacking you because of his actions. When I saved up enough money to come back to the US and help you possibly leave, it was too late. You’d all but disappeared. Nobody at L-Corp would tell me where you went. All the leads were gone.” 

“You tried to find me?” 

“Of course I did. You mean everything to me. I tried to fight them when they took you from me. But they had money, lawyers, body guards. I tried so hard. I’ve been trying to find you for so long.” 

Kara gave her hand a soft squeeze, “What do you want to do babe?” 

Lena’s heart was still racing next to her. “I just… I need a minute. It’s a lot to process.” 

Kara nodded and pressed a kiss to her temple, “How about we all have breakfast?” 

Kieran looked hopeful, Lena looked unsure, but she nodded anyway. Kara gave her hand another squeeze before dropping and moving to rest on the small of her back. Lena turned and padded back into the house where the girls were waiting. Kara let Kieran inside and locked the door behind her. 

“Thank you. This means so much to me. I can see you only have her best interest in mind.” 

Kara nodded, “Make no mistake, I won’t let you hurt her. But if you are actually her mom, I want her to have the chance to get to know you. It may take her some time. Her upbringing was… traumatic.” 

Kieran nodded as they rounded the corner into the kitchen. Lena was plating up pancakes, bacon, and eggs. Alexis was already in her high chair while Lily was sitting at the table. 

“Mommy who is that?” 

Kara grabbed another place setting and put it at the end of the table, next to where she and Lena would be sitting, with their girls on the other side of the table. “This is Kieran. She’s a friend of ours. She’s gonna have breakfast with us.” 

Lily shrugged, “Ok.” Then she turned to Lena, “Mummy, can I have bananas and strawberries on my pancakes?” 

Lena put a hand on the back of her head as she kissed the top of her head, “Of course darling.” She put a scoop of fruit on Lily’s plate while Kara cut up pancakes on Alexis’s high chair tray. 

“Please help yourself Kieran. We have coffee or tea if you’d like.” 

“Tea would be wonderful thank you.” 

Lily shovelled a piece of pancake into her mouth but didn’t let it stop her from trying to talk, “Thas ex’s mido nam.” 

Kara frowned, “Honey please don’t talk with food in your mouth.” 

It took a minute but she swallowed her food and looked back up at Kieran, “Sorry, that’s Lex’s middle name.” 

Kieran looked puzzled for a few seconds, “What do you mean?” 

Lena set a cup of tea down in front of the woman, “Her name is Alexis Kieran Luthor-Danvers.” 

The woman’s eyes welled with tears as Lena sat down next to her. Alexis was currently shoving pancakes into her mouth by the fistful. Kara reached over and gave her a scoop of fruit that was cut up into bite size pieces. 

The five of them all dug into their breakfast quietly. Lily and Alexis both asked for seconds of everything. None of the adults ate very much because of nerves on all sides of the table. 

Both girls got messy even though only Lily had syrup on her pancakes. Kara wiped Alexis’s little face and her hands while Lily went to wash her hands. “Lily you can put a movie on if you want.” 

“Ok mommy!” 

Kara held Alexis on her hip after cleaning her up. A little face pressed into the crook of her neck. Lena cleared the plates for something to do; Kara could hear her heart still beating faster than normal. 

“They’re beautiful little girls. How old are they?”  

Kara sat back down with Alexis snuggled into her arms. “Lily is 7. Alexis is going to be 1 next month.” She rubbed her back gently. 

“They grow up so fast,” she said looking at Alexis and then over Kara’s shoulder where Lena was putting dishes in the sink. “So how did you two meet?” 

Kara laughed a little, “We met in 2016. I was actually with my cousin who interviewed Lena when she first came to National City. We became really good friends after that. But I moved away in 2019 and didn’t come back for two years.” 

“Oh, so Lily isn’t…?” 

“No, Lily isn’t biologically Lena’s. Alexis is though.” 

Kieran’s hands held onto the mug in front of her. “I wish I could have been here for that.” 

“Well if it makes you feel any better, I carried her, not Lena.” 

“Oh, ok. Still. I’ve missed so many things.” 

Kara nodded, “But you’re here now. That’s what is important.” 

Lena came back into the room and pulled her chair up next to Kara’s. Alexis squirmed in her arms and reached toward Lena. In a practiced move she was shuffled from one mom to the other. Kara rested her arm on the back of her wife’s chair in a show of support. Alexis snuggled into Lena’s neck with a happy little sigh. 

“We have to verify your identity as I’m sure you understand.” 

Kieran nodded, “I’ll take any test you need me to. Blood, lie detector, anything.” 

Kara let her thumb rub little circles into her shoulder. Her phone buzzed with a message from Alex. There were quite a few messages but the most important was the one saying, ‘She’s Lena’s biological mother and she’s apparently still alive…’

“My sister works for the government and her wife is a police officer. It should only take a blood test but at least your identity checks out for now.” 

Lena pressed into her side lightly. “I have a lot of questions if that’s ok.” 

Kieran smiled in an almost perfect match to the one Kara saw on her wife most days. “I am happy to answer everything I can. Please ask me anything.” 

 

Lena took in a deep breath but nodded. Kara gave her shoulder a little squeeze in support. "What happened to get me taken away from you?"

31. Moments with mam?

Summary for the Chapter:

Kieran bonds with everyone

Notes for the Chapter:

Hi Everyone!

I'm sorry it's been a minute since I've uploaded. Grad school started again and my class is accelerated. It's going to be a long 7 weeks so don't expect another upload probably until after April 21st when my class ends.

Here's a fluffy little chapter of Kieran bonding with the girls and Lena. :)

This chapter is largely unedited so please don't mind the mistakes. I'll edit it when I get a free minute this week but I wanted to get something up for you all.

Happy reading!

Kieran looked over at her sadly, “I’m not sure if they ever told you but Lillian had a miscarriage. Her pregnancy wasn’t exactly publicized but it also wasn’t hidden. I didn’t know until later on that’s why they took you. She miscarried at 6 months, a little girl. I can’t even imagine how she felt in that moment… but then again, probably similar to how I felt when they took you. But then Lillian remembered, Lionel had another daughter... you.” 

 

Lena’s grip on Alexis tightened slightly, “So they took me?”

 

Kieran nodded, “He called and said he was coming to take you in a week's time. He promised you’d have the best education and would never want for anything. I told him I would never let you go. So I packed us a bag and we ran. I didn’t have a place in mind specifically so we just ran wherever we could. Place to place for a few weeks. You didn’t understand but I told you we were on an adventure. He caught up with us as we were about to leave Ireland. Had his people take you right from my arms. I begged him to leave us alone. He felt guilty for cheating on her and said he owed her this. So he took you. I filed police reports and hired lawyers but they were no match for the Luthor team. I’m so sorry Lena. I should have changed our names and our hair or something. I was so scared of losing you that I ended up losing you anyway.” 

 

Lena was quiet as Alexis snuggled further into her arms. “I would do the same for my girls. I can’t even imagine it…” Her gaze drifted down to the little body snuggled into her. 

 

Kieran watched the interaction, “We can talk about something happier if you want. How has your life been in the last few years? It seems much happier than when you last appeared in the tabloids.” 

 

Kara gave her shoulder a little squeeze in support as Lena took in a shaky breath, “It has been much happier. Kara and I were best friends before she moved away. She was a reporter in National City and one of the only people who actually believed I was making a difference in the world. She was really my first friend in a very long time. We had a little falling out before she left but it didn’t stop us from getting back together. After she left I took a big step back from L-Corp. I went into teaching and kind of disappeared off the grid. Kara happened to move back to National City with Lily in 2025. Somehow she ended up in my class. We had coffee and hung out like old times, and fell for each other pretty fast. The rest is history as cheesy as it sounds.” 

 

Alexis whined in her arms as she squirmed around trying to get comfortable. Lena rubbed her back softly, “Darling why don’t you go watch a movie with Lily? Maybe you can get all snuggly on the couch together.” Alexis let out an annoyed little huff. Kara couldn’t help but smile; she looked just like Lena when she was on the verge of getting mad. She grabbed the pacifier in front of Alexis’s place setting and held it out to her. Almost immediately a little hand grabbed it and stuffed it into her mouth. 

 

Lily appeared in the doorway, “Lex come on I put on the dinosaur show you like.” 

 

Lena lifted an eyebrow in her direction, “Which dinosaur show Lil?” 

 

Lily put her hands on her hips in Kara’s classic Supergirl pose, “Camp Cretaceous. You said we could watch it cause it’s not scary like the Jurassic Park movies.” 

 

Alexis wiggled off Lena’s lap and toddled over to her sister. Lily took her hand and the pair disappeared to the living room. Seconds later Kara could hear blankets shuffling as the sound of their show started up. Lena’s hand rested on her thigh under the table as Kieran’s attention turned back to them. 

 

Kara took a breath before starting, “I didn’t realize I was hopelessly in love with Lena the entire time we were friends. And we’d lost so much time when we came back together that neither of us took a long time to express our feelings. And we were both 100% in very quickly. We got married less than a year later. It would seem fast to some but we knew each other for years before and we knew what we wanted.” 

 

Kieran seemed a little shocked but smiled as she listened to Kara’s explanation, “That is very quick. But you two seem very happy. Tell me about the girls?” 

 

Lena tensed slightly next to her but Kara gave her a little squeeze for encouragement. “Lily is biologically Kara’s daughter. I did know her dad at one point. He’s not currently in the picture and probably will never be. Alexis is another story all together. She’s biologically both mine and Kara’s. I won’t get into the science of it right now (because she couldn’t without outing who Kara was) but Alexis shares both of our DNA.” 

 

“Oh wow, that’s amazing. I noticed her eyes right away, they’re beautiful.” 

 

Kara nodded in agreement, “I was hoping she would have Lena’s eyes. They’re my favorite thing in the world.” 

 

Lena gave her thigh a squeeze under the table again, “Are you going back to Ireland soon?” Kara reached her hand over and intertwined their fingers in support. She could feel Lena’s pulse starting to quicken as Kieran looked away. 

 

“I was hoping to stay around for a little bit. I’ve just been bouncing between air b&bs and motels for a few weeks. I would love to stay and get to know you and your family better, if that’s something you would be ok with.” 

 

Lena let out a breath she’d been holding as she nodded, “I would like that. Let me put you up in a nice place. Once Alex says your identity fully checks out maybe you can come stay with us for a little bit.” 

 

Kieran smiled, “I would love that. Just tell me when and where to be for whatever tests you guys need.” 

 

Kara cleared her throat, “I can have Alex bring over a swab today if you want.” 

 

Lena looked to the older woman, who nodded in agreement. “That’s fine with me.” 

 

~~~~~~~~~~~~~

 

A few hours later Kara and Lena were getting ready for bed together. Kara rubbed her wife’s back and looked over her shoulder to meet her eyes in the mirror as she brushed her teeth. “How are you holding up?” 

 

Lena let out a sigh as she spit out a mouthful of toothpaste, “Overwhelmed. Excited. Scared. Nervous. How is it possible? Was it true before the crisis too? Did Lionel really take me or was this something Lex cooked up during the crisis?” 

 

Kara frowned, “I’d like to believe Lex didn’t specifically do this to hurt you. But in a way… it kind of did the opposite. Alex said her identity checks out completely. She’s a perfect match to you. I can’t speak to if it’s from the crisis or not… but he did love you at one point Lena. Maybe he wanted you to have a chance to meet her if she was really gone before. Either way, she’s here now and how we proceed is up to you.” 

 

Lena rinsed her mouth and turned in Kara’s arms. Her face was immediately buried into Kara’s neck. Strong arms wrapped around her to hold her close. “I’m scared.” 

 

“I’ll be here no matter what you decide baby. El Mayarah. We have time to decide. You can just get to know her if you want. I don’t think we should out who I am and who the girls are yet because we don’t know her that well. But it wouldn’t hurt to spend some time with her and get to know her. I know it’s not the same but, spending time with my jeju turned out ok. We can do whatever you want baby there’s no pressure to decide right now.” 

 

Lena sighed and snuggled further into her arms. Kara kissed her head lightly as she guided them out of the bathroom and to their bed. They snuggled up together under the blankets. Kara ran her fingers through Lena’s hair for a few minutes before she finally said anything, “I think I’d like to get to know her.” 

 

Kara pressed a soft kiss to her forehead, “I’ll be with you every step of the way if you want me to.” 

 

Lena nodded while threading her freehand with Kara’s. “I don’t want to get hurt again.” 

 

“I know babe. But it’ll hurt even more if you miss the chance to get to know her.” 

 

A sigh could be heard as another nod came. They snuggled down together and tried to sleep. 

 

~~~~~~~~~~~~

 

The next two weeks passed quickly for everyone. Kieran had been having lunch with them the first week and then dinner the next. Slowly they allowed the girls to join them when she was over. Both Lena and Kara were wary of the girls getting attached, not knowing what Kieran’s future living arrangements were. The girls seemed to enjoy her presence just as much as they enjoyed Eliza and Alura’s though. Despite how much time they were spending together, Lena still had not called Kieran mum since that first initial meeting. Kara noticed the sad look first. 

 

The girls had just come in from playing in the backyard with Kara while Kieran and Lena baked scones. Lily immediately ran to the duo in the kitchen, “Mummy can I help?!” 

 

Her little blue eyes shined up at Lena who softened immediately. Kara watched her wife caress their daughters cheek, “Of course love. Go wash your hands and get your apron.” With a bright smile mirroring Kara’s, she ran off to the bathroom. Kara noticed the sad expression on Kieran’s face for a moment before she hid it when Lena turned back to her. 

 

Alexis made her discontent known as she whined and wiggled in Kara’s arms. Her little hands reaching for Lena. “Lex you’re ok. Come on let’s go get cleaned up squirt.”

 

 Little green eyes filled with tears as she opened and closed her hands in Lena’s direction. Her wife crossed the room and took the little squirming one from her arms. “I’ve got her Kar. Can you just make sure Lily actually washed her hands when she comes back?” 

 

“Of course Lee.” She couldn’t help but laugh a little as Alexis snuggled her face into Lena’s neck and a tiny fist clenched her shirt. Kara watched her wife and daughter ascend the stairs before turning back to Kieran. 

 

“She’s wonderful with the girls. I wish I had been here to see her just starting out as a mother.” 

 

Kara propped a hip against the counter, “Anything she’s learned about being a mom comes from the few memories she has of you.” 

 

Kieran looked away while fiddling with a towel, “You’re just being kind.” 

 

Kara reached out and rested a hand on her arm gently, “No I’m being honest with you. Lillian was never a mom to Lena. I only actually heard her being referred to as mom once, and mother a handful of times. Lillian was not warm and welcoming to her. She’s actually one of the main reasons Lena was so scared she wouldn’t be a good mom. We both had not so great experiences with our parents. I was adopted when I was 13 and while I love my adoptive mother, I was terrified of having my own kids.” 

 

“I can’t even imagine the stress and worry you had about having your own family alongside all the danger in your lives.” 

 

Kara paused as she thought of her answer carefully, “Lena and I lead private lives for the girls safety. She was terrified of them being targeted because of the Luthor name. We work hard to keep them safe. It was definitely something we were afraid of and both thought about even back when we were just friends. We didn’t think a family was in the cards for either of us.” 

 

Kieran placed a hand atop Kara’s, “The one reason I knew I could stay in Ireland for as long as I did is because of you. I knew you would protect her. It was all over the news. I just thought, ‘well if I can’t bring her back to Ireland to protect, the next best thing is Supergirl’.” 

 

Kara sputtered as Lena descended the stairs and put Alexis down in front of her toys in the main room, “I-i-i… I’m not…” 

 

Lena’s hand rested on the small of her back lightly as Kieran continued talking, “It’s alright Kara. It was the way you looked at her that gave it away. The tabloids captured the two of you as Lena and Supergirl as well as Lena and Kara; it was unmistakable to me that you were one in the same. I was so happy that with the cruel hand my little girl had been dealt, she’d still found someone who loved her so much. I knew with the way you looked at her that you would protect her with your life.”

 

Kara leaned into her wife’s side as Kieran let go of her hand. She reached over to tangle their fingers together, wedding rings brushing as she did so. “I would lay down my life for her in a heartbeat.” 

 

Lena quirked an eyebrow, “She actually flew into an area with a kryptonite bomb to save me. She’s saved my life multiple times. I am forever indebted to her.” 

 

Kara scoffed, “Please, you’ve saved me too. Nobody is in debt to the other.” 

 

Kieran smiled at the pair as Kara pressed a kiss to Lena’s temple. Lily ran in with an apron around her neck, “Mum can you tie this for me?” 

 

Lena kneeled down and tied it, “Of course lilybug. Are you excited to make scones?” 

 

“Yep!” Her little blue eyes shifted up to Kieran and then back to Lena. “Mummy, what’s the irish word for grandma?” 

 

Kara heard both Kieran and Lena’s hearts stutter as well as their breathing stop. Kara rested a hand on the back of Lily’s head. Little blue eyes looked up at her, “She’s our grandma right?” 

 

“What made you think that Lil?” 

 

Lily looked at her like she’d grown a third head, “She looks just like mummy. And Alexis’s middle name is Kieran too.” Her head turned back to Lena, “She’s your mum right?” 

 

Lena nodded and cleared her throat, “Yes she’s my mum. But we have to ask people what they would like to be called, it’s polite to ask.” 

 

Lily turned to look up at Kieran, “I already have a grandma that we sometimes call nana. And i’ve got a grandma that we call uzheiu sometimes. What can we call you?” 

 

Kieran swallowed back the lump in her throat and blinked back her tears, “You can call me mam ó. It means grandma in Irish.” 

 

Lily smiled brightly, “Ok. Can you show mummy and me how to make scones mam ó?” 

 

With a shaky nod Kieran took Lily’s hand and led her over to the counter and set her to stand on a chair so she could reach. Kara reached out and gave Lena’s hand a squeeze as tears rolled down her cheeks. “I’m here baby.” 

 

“I just… I never thought…” Tears kept sliding down her cheeks as Kara pulled her close. One hand cupped her cheek as her thumb brushed away the tears. 

 

“I know love. But she’s here. She wants to be here. She loves you. It’s ok to let her in. She won’t hurt you like so many other people have,” she whispered. Lena nodded and sniffled. 

 

Lily’s little voice pulled them apart, “Mummy are you coming?” 

 

Lena cleared her throat, “Of course darling.” Kara cradled her face in her hands and wiped away her fallen tears. She watched as Lena crossed the kitchen to rest a hand on Lily’s back as Kieran talked them through the instructions on how to make scones. 

 

Kara left them to go check on Alexis, whom she found playing quietly with a little dinosaur toy. Lena had changed her into a one piece dinosaur onesie with a spiked hood and all. It was one of Kara’s favorite outfits they’d gotten. “Hi little bean. Can jeju play dinosaurs with you?” 

 

A little hand held up a dinosaur that she took with a laugh. “Thank you Lex. That was such good sharing. Can you tell me what dinosaurs say?” 

 

Her little emerald eye’d beauty flashed her a smile, “Rawrrrrrr.” 

 

Kara smiled brightly, “That’s right!” She made her dinosaur walk all around the carpet by Alexis’s, both of them rawr’ing as they did so. Quietly the trio made scones in the kitchen with minimal instruction, Kara kept a listen out as she played with Alexis. 

 

After about a half hour of playing Kara scooped up Alexis and laid on her back, holding her daughter above her. “It’s superbaby! Fly lex! Save the day!” Alexis giggled above her as she kicked her little legs. 

 

Kara looked over to the doorway when she heard quiet laughs. Kieran and Lena were standing in the doorway watching her with Alexis. “What? We got bored and the dinosaurs were attacking National City, right Lex?” Alexis giggled. 

 

Lily ran over and pulled Alexis’s hood up so she looked like a little dinosaur. “Oh no it’s babyzilla! She’s gonna get us!” Kara set Alexis down and both she and Lily pretended to run away from the little dino. 

 

Alexis giggled as she ran after them. Lily ran around the couch, behind the table, and ended up standing on a chair. Kara let Alexis chase after her around the couch, the coffee table, to the chair. Lily dramatically jumped into her arms (who she easily caught) and yelled, “Help mommy! Babyzilla is gonna eat me!” 

 

“Save yourself bug!” Kara called out as she dramatically set Lily down and pushed her towards Lena while falling to the ground as Alexis flopped on top of her. 

 

“Rawrrrrrrr!” 

 

“Ahhh she’s got me!” Kara cried as she wrapped her arms around her daughter. “Don’t forget me Lily!” She looked up to where Lily was now hiding behind Lena with her arms wrapped around her leg. 

 

“I won’t mommy!” 

 

“Tell mummy I love her!” 

 

Lily looked up at Lena and tugged on her leg, “Mommy loves you. Babyzilla is gonna eat her, she saved me!” 

 

Kara dramatically closed her eyes and let her tongue flop out the side of her mouth. All four of them laughed at her performance. She peeked open an eye, “Uh oh babyzilla, Superwoman is gonna get you!” 

 

Kara held Alexis tight to her chest as she started floating a few feet off the ground. She quickly spun so Alexis was under her and started kissing all over her daughter’s face. Little giggles were music to her ears and warmed her heart. 

 

“I’ll save you babyzilla!” Lily raced over to help her sister. She jumped up trying to grab ahold of Alexis’s foot. Kara laughed lightly as she swooped down just enough to scoop up Lily too. She flipped back onto her back so the girls were on her chest above her. 

 

“I’ve got you now girls, there’s nowhere to go,” she gave a fake evil laugh. 

 

All of a sudden there was a squeaky high pitched voice yelling, “Mam!” 

 

Lena couldn’t hold back her smile as Alexis wiggled in Kara’s arms trying to get her attention. “She can’t save you now little monster!” 

 

Lily, the little sas monster decided it was her turn to talk, “Mummy always beats you jeju. You can’t say no to her.” 

 

Kara sighed and pretended to be annoyed, “Shh don’t tell all my secrets bug.” 

 

Lena laughed as she came towards them. Kara comically floated backwards a few feet. An eyebrow arched in her direction followed by crossed arms. “I highly suggest you release the two monsters to my care Superwoman.” 

 

“And why would I do that Ms. Luthor?” 

 

“If you want a scone you’ll unhand the little monsters.” 

 

Kara pouted, “That’s not fair.” 

 

Lena smirked and held her arms out, “Food or the babies.” 

 

Kara sighed but dramatically handed over Alexis to Lena’s waiting arms. “And the other?” Lena rested Alexis on her hip while she waited for Lily to be unhanded. Kara wrapped her arms around Lily and covered her face in kisses. 

 

“But she’s so cute. Can’t I just keep one of them?” 

 

“All or nothing Superwoman.” 

 

“Fine, they need baths anyway. They’re stinky monsters.” She set Lily down carefully on her feet. Then she floated back down to the ground herself. “I don’t know why they like you more. I’m the one who can fly.” 

 

Lena laughed, “Because I give the best nighttime cuddles and read the best stories.” 

 

“Hey! I’m a great cuddler!” Kara put her hands on her hips in her traditional Supergirl pose. 

 

“I’m not saying you aren’t. I’m just saying I’m better.” 

 

“That’s not fair!” Kara pouted. 

 

“Do you disagree? Are my cuddles not the best?” 

 

Kara groaned, she couldn’t argue with that. Her favorite thing was snuggling up in bed with her wife. “I’m going to put the laundry away.” 

 

“That’s what I thought. We’ll call when the scones are done.” 

 

“Yea, yea.” Kara pouted as she went off to the laundry room where the dryer had just finished its cycle. A few seconds later she could hear both the girls laughing with Lena. It brought a smile to her face knowing how much she loved their girls. 

 

Kara went to work getting out the load of dry clothes. She moved the load from the washer into the dryer, threw in a dryer sheet, and set it to a 40 minute tumble. At their little table she sorted the clothes into four piles. It was easy to tell whose clothes were whose. She made quick work of folding little pairs of pants, shirts, and onesies. The house of El crest on a little blue onesie, a Unicorn on a small t shirt. Tiny socks that always seemed to lose the matching one. The two stacks were moved into a laundry basket that always went up to the girls rooms. Then she folded hers and Lena's clothes. MIT and NCU sweatshirts, nerdy science meme t shirts, cartoon shirts, and yoga pants piled up. The piles went into another basket that would go up to their room. 

 

It was an even quicker job to fold the few bath towels and washcloths. Those went into a third basket for the bathroom. Arms slid around her waist after about 10 minutes of folding. Lena’s head pressed lightly against her shoulder. “The girls are demolishing the scones.” 

 

Kara laughed, “Well they are both half my DNA babe. Imagine if they both develop powers and a kryptonian appetite.” 

 

Lena groaned, “I’m gonna have to make sure L-Corp cures cancer or I won’t be able to afford all that food. How did you ever afford it on a reporter's salary?” 

 

Kara rested a hand atop the folded ones on her stomach, “We had a lot of game nights where everyone brought food. And sometimes Supergirl was rewarded with free food. I honestly couldn’t afford it. The DEO didn’t pay me until almost when I left for Argo. We’ll have more than enough money to feed the girls. If need be I’ll just wear my red sun bracelet so I won’t have to eat as much.” She shrugged at the last comment. 

 

It was like she could feel Lena frown against her shoulder, “I would never ask you to do that Kara. I am more than capable of supporting my family. You should never have to dampen your powers for something like eating. That’s unacceptable.” 

 

“It’s alright Lena. Sometimes it’s almost better if I do. Then I don’t feel hungry all the time. It was kind of nice spending most of this year not starving 24/7 just because of my biology. Sure I was hungry because I was breastfeeding Alexis, but it’s not the same exactly.” 

 

Lena was quiet for a moment before she spoke, “Does it hurt?” 

 

Kara gave her hand a squeeze, “Our girls will never feel it as long as we can help it. I promise you. Come on let’s go get a scone before they’re all out.” She turned and rested her arms around Lena’s neck. Their lips met in a slow kiss. It still caused butterflies to erupt in her stomach. Lena’s arms around her tightened slightly. 

 

“I love you Kar.” 

 

“I love you too baby.” 

 

They made their way into the kitchen and were met with the sweetest sight. Alexis was sitting on Kieran’s lap, Lily was pressed close to her side. Both girls were busy chomping away at the scones. Jam was smeared all over Alexis’s hands and cheeks. Lily seemed to be slightly less messy, just crumbs littering her lap. 

 

Kara and Lena sat down to enjoy some scones as well. Kara took a bite and immediately let out a moan. “These are amazing.” Lena’s cheeks flushed at the noise. 

 

A few hours later Kieran had gone back to the Air B&B she was staying at close by. Lily had begged to go stay with Alex and Maggie for the night, and Alexis had just been bathed. Kara set her on the floor of her room while she picked out some pajamas. She looked back at her little girl and couldn't help but smile. Alexis was standing in the center of the room looking back at her. Her little green eyes were as expressive as Lena’s. The hood on her towel was pulled up over her head. Her little feet stuck out from under the towel but her hands were buried inside it. Kara held out her arms, “Come here sweetie.” Alexis toddled over to her right away. 

 

It had been a long day for them all with lots of playing. It was understandable that her little one would be tired. Kara heard feet padding up the stairs quietly but kept up what she was doing. She laid her little girl down on the floor and opened her towel up. With practiced ease she slid a diaper under her butt and fastened it. She leaned down to blow a raspberry on her little belly. Alexis giggled and kicked her feet. Kara caught her foot and pretended to eat it. It caused her to giggle even louder. “Are you ready for your pj’s? Then we can go snuggle with mum and watch a show.” She let go of the foot and slid pants onto her legs. Then she lifted her up so she was standing and put the matching shirt on. She finished it up with a kiss to her forehead. Alexis rubbed her eye with a closed fist while the other clenched to her shirt. She was ready for bed. 

 

“I know love, it was a long day.” Kara tossed the towel on the changing table and scooped her little one up in her arms. She turned to see Lena in the doorway watching them. 

 

“I love watching you with the girls. You’re the best mom ever.” 

 

Kara kissed her nose as she walked past, “The same goes for you. Though I’m pretty sure they prefer you to me so that makes you the best.” 

 

“Hardly, you’re amazing with them.” The trio made their way into the master bedroom. Kara settled onto her side of the bed as Lena turned on a show for them to watch. In a practiced move she shucked off her shirt and cradled Alexis in her arms. The only times she was still breastfeeding her were first thing in the morning and just before bedtime. Alexis latched onto her nipple immediately. Lena got onto her side of the bed and snuggled up to them. Kara reached over and tangled their fingers together. 

 

“How are you doing with everything?” 

 

“It’s been so much to process but it’s been wonderful. She’s been wonderful with me and the girls. I’m just afraid she’s going to go back to Ireland and I won’t get to see her for a long time.” 

 

“Well your wife does fly, and you do have private jets. So you could hypothetically see her more often than the average person.” 

 

Lena gave her hand a squeeze, “You know what I mean.” 

 

Kara hummed in agreement, “I know. Maybe she’ll move around here to be close. You’re her only daughter and they’re her only grandkids. Just ask her about it, love.” 

 

“I’m just scared. What if she doesn’t want to live here? What if this hasn’t been what she expected?” 

 

“Lena, she loves you. It’s clear as day. She loves the girls too.” 

 

“She hasn’t said anything like that to me,” she replied quietly. 

 

“She will. I’m sure of it. How could anyone not love you?” 

 

Lena scoffed, “You’re immensely biased darling.” 

 

“I never said I wasn’t. Now can you put on something that isn’t a kids cartoon. I know I love Disney movies but I could use a real adult show tonight.” 

 

Lena turned on a food show they were watching and snuggled in closer to her side. “Thank you for being here Kar. I wouldn’t make it without you.” 

 

Kara gave her hand a squeeze, “I wouldn’t be anywhere else baby. I love you so much.” 

 

“I love you too.”

Notes for the Chapter:

Comments and kudos appreciated! Next up, Kieran and Lena have a heart to heart. Will Lena finally hear 'I love you' from Kieran? I'll try not to keep you guys hanging for too long but no promises!

32. Mother's Day

Summary for the Chapter:

A little break from our regularly scheduled content in honor of Mother's Day here in the US. A little look at two different mother's days for Kara

Notes for the Chapter:

Hi everyone! I wanted to drop a fluffy little chapter in honor of Mother's Day. Comments and Kudos are appreciated!

Sunday May 10th, 2020

 

It wasn’t the sun that woke Kara. No, it was quiet talking and cooing coming from the corner of her room; the rocking chair to be precise. She cracked an eye open to see her mom cradling her newborn in her arms. Her little Lily was just 8 days old and was perfect. Her lips quirked up into a smile watching her mom with her daughter.

 

“Happy Mother’s Day,” she said sleepily.

 

Alura’s eyes lifted from her granddaughter to meet Kara’s. “An earth holiday?”  

 

“Yea. There’s a day for mothers and one for fathers.”

 

“Well in that case, thank you and Happy Mother’s Day to you too.”

 

Kara couldn’t help but smile wider. “That sounds so weird to hear.”

 

Alura smiled, “Be that as it may, it doesn’t make it any less true. I never thought I’d get to have this. To see you with your own kids.”

 

Kara sat up and stretched as her mom got up from the rocking chair and made her way over to the bed. She sat down next to Kara and handed Lily over. Kara cradled her little girl close to her chest. The warm weight on her chest grounded her.

 

Lily had blonde peach fuzz on her head. Her eyes were still that baby blue that had yet to turn a true blue. Kara hoped that Lily would have her eyes and not Mon-El’s. It would just be a reminder that he’d left them.

 

Alura’s arm settled around her shoulders and Kara leaned into her. “I was thinking of going to see Eliza today. Introduce her to Lily since she hasn’t been able to come here.”

 

Lips pressed a soft kiss to her temple. “I think she would love that honey.”

 

Kara leaned further into her embrace as a tiny fist closed around her finger. “I resented her for so long. I thought she was trying to replace you. I was so angry when I landed and Kal-El just deserted me. I was prepared to take care of him when I was only 13, and he was a grown adult who couldn’t take care of a teenager. I pushed them all away for months. Eliza has always been so kind and loving to me. She’s always treated me as her daughter.”

 

Alura gave her shoulders a squeeze, “Of course she did. A mother’s love is unconditional. She knew you were hurting. It didn’t make her love you any less because you didn’t call her mom. Go see her and Alex for a few days. I went years with you on earth, I’ll be ok for a few days sweetheart.”

 

A few hours later Kara was stepping through the portal with Lily sleeping in a sling across her chest and a backpack diaper bag slung across her shoulders. A red sun bracelet was firmly attached to her wrist.

 

As soon as she stepped through the portal Alex was waiting. “Where’s my niece?!”

 

Kara smiled, “Hi Kara how are you doing since you pushed a tiny human out of your body? I’m just dandy Alex thanks for asking.”

 

Alex rolled her eyes with a smile as she carefully wrapped an arm around her sister’s shoulders. “I’m so glad you’re here. How are you feeling?”

 

“Just sore and tired. Being human is difficult and being a tiny human is even more difficult.” As if she knew they were talking about her, Lily’s little hand flopped out of the sling. Kara laughed as Alex’s whole face lit up.

 

“Pleaseeeee let me hold her. Please, please, please.”

 

Kara carefully lifted her little girl out of the sling and rested her against her chest. “Well good morning sweet girl. Do you wanna go see Auntie Alex?”

 

Lily’s little mouth opened in a yawn. Kara carefully handed her over to Alex’s waiting arms. Warmth spread through her chest seeing her sister cradle her daughter in her arms. Immediately all Alex’s attention was on Lily.

 

“You’ve gotten even cuter since I saw you last lily bug.”

 

Kara shook her head at the nickname, “One week and she’s already got a nickname.”

 

Alex scoffed, “Her first nickname should come from her favorite person. If I’d been able to stay longer she would have had one on day one.”

 

“I know. Do you know if Eliza’s home? We were gonna drop in for Mother’s Day.”

 

 “I can’t imagine where else she’d be on a Sunday. Maggie and I were gonna stop by later. Are you staying for just today or a few days?”

 

Kara adjusted the bag on her back, “I was thinking a few days. If Eliza doesn’t have the time I can always go back early.”

 

“No, no need for that. You can always stay with Maggie and I. We are more than happy to keep the two of you with us.”

 

Kara laughed, “You might want to ask your wife before you offer your home to a first time mom and a week old newborn.”

 

Alex scoffed, “Shh. You’re our sister. You’re always welcome in our home.”

 

Kara smiled softly. “Thanks Alex. I’ve missed you.”

 

“I know you have. Now come on let’s go give you both a quick check up and then go see mom.”

 

~~~~~~~~~~~

 

Two hours later Kara was waiting for Eliza to arrive at the Tower. Alex had told her that she needed her input on some project but didn’t tell her that Kara was there.

 

“Alex what was so urgent that you needed me for?”

 

Kara smiled hearing Eliza’s voice. She stepped out from the small lab she’d been waiting in. “Surprise!”

 

Eliza smiled and immediately enveloped her in a hug. Kara sunk into her embrace. “Happy Mother’s Day.”

 

Eliza pulled back to cradle Kara’s face in her hands. “Thank you and Happy Mother’s day right back to you. You look exhausted sweetheart.”

 

“I don’t think I’ve ever been this tired in my entire life. But it’s worth every exhausting second.”

 

Eliza smiled and stroked her cheek, “How are you feeling? Has Alex given you a check up yet? How’s Lily?”

 

Kara smiled, “I’m alright, yes Alex already checked me out, and why don’t you see for yourself.”

 

Alex rounded the corner with Lily in her arms happily drinking a bottle. Kara took her daughter from her sister and carefully transferred her to Eliza’s arms. “She’s so beautiful Kara. I can already see you in her features.”

 

“Well let’s hope certain features from me stay hidden for at least ten years or more. I don’t want to be dealing with a floating baby anytime soon.”

 

Alex laughed from her spot next to them, “We’ll upgrade the red sun bracelets that Clark uses on the boys for Lily just in case.”

 

Kara nodded, “I would seriously appreciate not having a toddler with laser vision or freeze breath.”

 

Eliza reached over and stroked her cheek, “You’ll get her through it. You’re an amazing mom already sweetheart. I’m so proud of you.”

 

Kara wrapped her arms around Eliza from the side and rested her head on her shoulder while looking down at her little girl. It was going to be hard doing it alone but she was going to love every minute of her life.  

 

Sunday May 9th, 2027

 

The sun was trying to peek it’s way around their blackout curtains. But it was quiet talking that woke her from the wonderful sleep she’d been in. “There we go. All better with a clean diaper and a full belly.”

 

Kara opened her eyes when the bed dipped next to her. Lena was settling back against their mountain of pillows with Alexis in her arms. “I’m sorry darling, did we wake you?”

 

Kara hummed, “It’s ok I normally get up around this time anyway.”

 

“You can go back to sleep love. She’s ready in a clean diaper and fed. I’m sure she’s going to fall back to sleep soon too.”

 

“That’s ok. I’ll just snuggle my girls for awhile.” She scooted closer to her wife until her front was pressed to Lena’s side. She only had to lean over slightly to press a soft kiss to her baby girl’s head before settling back on her pillow. “Good morning sweetheart. I hope you had sweet dreams.” Her hand rested on the little back of her daughter. Little green eyes sparkled back at her and a gummy smile tugged her lips up.

 

Kara smiled before looking up to meet her favorite emerald eyes, “Happy Mother’s Day baby.”

 

Lena smiled back at her, “Happy Mother’s day darling.”

 

Kara slid an arm across her wife’s waist as she snuggled in closer. Little feet could be heard pounding down the hall and it was only seconds before their door was being thrown open. “Happy Mother’s day!” Lily exclaimed as she ran into their room. Her feet left the ground as she launched herself onto their bed.

 

Kara rolled onto her back and pulled Lily into her arms. “Thank you bug. Without you and Lex we wouldn’t be able to celebrate today. So I think that means mama and I should celebrate the two of you as well. That sounds fair doesn’t it?”

 

Lily tapped her chin, “Does that mean we all get pancakes today?”

 

Lena chuckled next to her, “We can all have pancakes sweetheart.”

 

Lily giggled, “Ok!” Her little hand reached over and rested on her sister’s back. “Morning Lex. Happy Mother’s day mummy.”

 

“Thank you Lil. How about we have some family cuddles?”

 

“Ok!” She agreed and snuggled closer into Kara’s arms. Kara ran a hand up and down her back lightly. Her life had changed so much in the past few years but she wouldn’t have it any other way.

33. Summer Days

Summary for the Chapter:

A little look into the Luthor-Danvers busy life. They get some time to connect with Alex and Maggie too!

Notes for the Chapter:

I definitely uploaded this to the wrong fic earlier. I hope you guys enjoy this chapter. A little fluffy-ish one with a little scary moment. As always all mistakes are my own.

June 10th, 2028 

 

Alexis - 1 year old

Lily - 8 years old

 

Kara couldn’t help but look in the rearview mirror again. One rear facing car seat was clearly visible with a forward facing one just across from it. Lily had a stuffed bunny in her hand and was making it ‘fly’ across the gap between the seats and land on her sister’s belly. Kara couldn’t help but smile at her girls. 

 

“You girls are being so good for mommy today. I think you deserve to pick out a treat when we get to Target. What do you think Lil?” 

 

Blue eyes met hers in the mirror, “Yea! We’re being so good! We promised mummy we would be.” 

 

Kara pulled into the car wash, one of the girl’s favorite places to go when they were out running errands, and paid the attendant. “You’ve been very good today. I think we can get a treat and maybe a toy for you girls to share. How does that sound?” 

 

“Mama!” Came Alexis’s little squeaky voice from the rear facing seat. 

 

“We’ll get a good toy Lex, don't worry,” Lily reassured her sister. She put the bunny on her belly and turned her attention to the window as colored bubbles covered their car. Kara could feel her wife cringing from miles away as the girl’s little fingers touched the windows. It didn’t matter how often they cleaned the back windows, there were always fingerprints on them. It drove Lena nuts. 

 

“Lex look! Your favorite color!” Lily reached over and grabbed her little sister’s hand.

 

Alexis squeaked again, “Mama! Pupple!” 

 

“You’re right baby girl, it’s purple. What color is coming next?” 

 

Blue soap started to cover the windows next. “Boo!” 

 

Kara scrunched her nose up as she smiled at how cute her girls were, “You’re right baby girl!” 

 

A few minutes later they were through the car wash and heading to her guilty pleasure, Target. She maneuvered the car into a parking spot and turned it off. Slinging her purse across her body, she got out and opened the door to get Alexis out. Lily had already unbuckled herself and was climbing across the car to ‘help’ unbuckle her sister. Kara smiled watching Lily undo the buckle and move the harness off her sister. 

 

“Ok girls you know the rules. Stay by mommy at all times, ok?” 

 

Lily nodded and Alexis made grabby hands up at her. She scooped up her little girl and settled her onto her hip. Lily hopped out of the car and held onto her pocket while she shut the door and locked the car. Her free hand found the one gripping onto her pocket and she made her way into the store with both of her girls. 

 

While she could easily carry both girls without ever getting tired, it wasn’t easy to keep track of them in stores. So she got a buggy and put Alexis in the seat while Lily climbed onto the front of it to ride on. “Ok we’ve gotta get some stuff to bring to Tia and Auntie’s.” She pushed the buggy into the produce section. “Do you girls want watermelon?” 

 

“Yea, can we get strawberries too?” Lily countered. 

 

“Of course,” Kara put two containers of cut up watermelon in the buggy along with one of strawberries. 

 

“Nana,” Alexis said pointing at bananas. 

 

Kara kissed her forehead, “We can get some bananas too. Even though you girls just devour those at home.” She put a bunch of bananas in the cart. The trio made their way through the refrigerated section adding a few odds and ends into the cart. 

 

It wasn’t usual for Kara to have the girls all to herself. Normally Lena would do the shopping with them because the girls could be a handful. But today she’d had to put out a few fires at L-Corp so Kara volunteered to go solo. Her involvement at L-Corp was minimal but today was just one of those days where they needed the boss’s help. 

 

They were going to Alex and Maggie’s later for a barbeque. They rotated houses every week for family dinners but they hadn’t had a day all together in a few weeks. Life had been busy for both families. Lily kept them busy with softball three nights a week, both girls were in a swim class that met two days a week, and their jobs were hectic. Of course they still saw their sisters, Maya was in the same swim class as Alexis. But it had been almost a month since their last official family get together.  

 

“Ok you girls can each get a treat for later.” 

 

Lily tapped her chin while looking at the refrigerated cases. She hopped off the cart and started to walk up and down the aisle, looking at everything she could possibly choose. Finally her little eyes lit up as she pulled the door open. “Can I have the frozen chocolate bananas mommy?” 

 

Kara reached up and grabbed the box down, “Those are a good choice. I think even mama would be ok with those as a treat.” She let Lily put the box into the cart. “What do you think Lex would like?” 

 

Lily looked up at her little sister and the signature Danvers crinkle appeared. “She liked those blueberry chocolate things mummy got her last time we were at the store.” 

 

It took Kara a few seconds to recall what Lily was talking about. But then she remembered Lena had gotten some chocolate covered blueberry bite things that the girls had loved. They were perfect for the car when they needed to quiet them down. It took a few minutes but eventually they found the aforementioned snacks. Kara put two packs in the cart and then made her way toward the toy aisles. 

 

“Do you girls want to get a toy for the pool or for home?” 

 

Lily looked over at her little sister, “Pool or home lex?” 

 

“Swimmy!” 

 

“Can we look at the pool toys mommy?” 

 

Kara smiled at her girls, “Of course. Nothing too big though. We’ve gotta be able to take it home with us later.” 

 

After some serious deliberation they settled on a little shark net set. There were two sharks that had handles on them and a net coming out of the back. Two little sets of fish would float in the water and the girls could make the sharks ‘eat’ them. The trio made their way to check out where the line was a little long. Lily moved to stand on the cart where Kara was pushing from so she could play with her sister. Alexis was rubbing her eyes but letting her sister kiss her face and tickle her. 

 

Kara kept one hand on the cart as she checked her phone. 

 

Lena: I just finished up. Should I just meet you guys at Alex and Maggie’s?

 

Kara: If you want to that’s fine. We’re in the checkout at Target right now. The line is going to take at least twenty minutes :( The girls are going to pass out the second I get them in the car. 

 

Lily looked up at her and wrapped an arm around her leg, “When is mummy gonna be done working?” 

 

Kara stroked her cheek, “She just finished.” 

 

“I miss her.” Kara lifted her up onto her hip and felt her daughter bury her face in her neck. 

 

“I know bug. You’ll see her soon. Do you wanna help put the stuff on the conveyor when we get up there?” 

 

“I’m getting sleepy, so is Lex.” 

 

Kara kissed her head, “You girls can take a nap when we drive to Auntie and Tia’s. We won’t be here too much longer.” 

 

Lily nodded while looping her arms around Kara’s neck. She held onto her daughter as they waited in line. Alexis was starting to fuss in the cart as her little eyelids drooped. Kara could tell at least one meltdown was going to happen if she didn’t get the girls in the car fast. A quick check in her purse proved worthwhile when she found the handy little pacifier carrying case they had for emergencies. Alexis only used a pacifier for naps and sleeping, it was the only thing that could hold off a tantrum. 

 

She held up the pacifier for her daughter and let out a sigh of relief when she popped it right into her mouth. Lily snuggled into her neck more. “Tired mommy.” Kara rubbed her back gently as she moved side to side in a slow sway. 

 

“I know sweetheart. It won’t be too much longer until we’re in the car I promise.” 

 

The next five minutes were spent trying to keep the girls calm. A hand slipped onto her lower back and she almost jumped out of her skin at the touch. When she whipped around she breathed a sigh of relief. “I thought you could use some backup Hector dropped me off here instead.” 

 

“Mummy,” Lily yawned. 

 

“Hi my love. You look pretty sleepy.” 

 

Lily nodded, her head still resting on Kara’s shoulder. “Are you done working now?” 

 

Lena’s finger tips rubbed into her small back, “I’m all done working now. Did you girls have a good day with mommy?” 

 

“Mhm. Gotta car wash and treats.” 

 

Lena smiled and pressed a soft kiss to her head. “That sounds like a pretty wonderful day to me.” 

 

They managed to get their groceries on the belt quickly by working together. In another ten minutes they were making their way to the parking lot. Lena pushed the cart while Kara held Lily against her chest tucked into her neck. When they got to the car it was a quick transfer of kids into car seats. Ten minutes later Kara was sliding into the passenger seat as Lena started up their car. 

 

“It’s pretty quiet back there,” Kara whispered. They both turned to find both girls fast asleep in their car seats. Alexis’s pacifier bobbed up and down as she slept. Lily’s head rested on the side of her car seat as she dozed. Kara reached back and pulled the sun shades down over the windows to lessen the chance of the girls waking up from the light. 

 

She turned back around and laced her fingers with Lena’s as they pulled out of their spot and onto the road. “At least we’ve got a half hour before we have to be at Alex and Maggie’s. It’s not a great nap but it should be enough to keep them happy for awhile. If need be we can always put them in Maya’s room when we get there to sleep for awhile longer,”  Lena said. 

 

Kara nodded while giving her hand a squeeze, “Yea. They were really good today. No tantrums or tears or anything. They’ve been asking how much longer until they get to see Maggie and Alex all day. I was starting to think they were getting sick of us.” 

 

Lena chuckled, “I’m sure they just miss getting spoiled by their Aunts.” 

 

Kara hummed in agreement. “I’ve got all our stuff I think. Bathing suits, a change of clothes for all of us, and the food. I also packed the girls blankets and stuffies for sleeping. I have a feeling we’re gonna have really tired girls later too.” 

 

“Yea I bet we will,” she agreed. 

 

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

 

Lena parked in Alex and Maggie’s driveway 45 minutes later. Both girls were still sound asleep in their car seats. “Let’s get unloaded and then come back for the girls.” 

 

Quietly they unloaded their bags of clothing and food. Maggie and Alex came outside with Maya. “Took you guys long enough,” Alex teased. 

 

“The girls are asleep. They passed out in the Target parking lot. We may have to put them down for another half hour if that’s ok,” Kara said. 

 

Alex’s expression softened, “Of course. The guest room is made up and Maya’s room is clean. We can get started cooking food first until they wake up if you guys want.” 

 

“They might wake up when we move them so we’ll see. Whatever you guys want to do is fine with us.” 

 

Lena and Maggie took the bags into the house while Kara quietly opened the back door. Alexis was always the easier one to move first because she slept like the dead. Kara made quick work of unbuckling her and scooping her up into her arms. She passed her off to Alex and then moved onto Lily’s side of the car. 

 

She tried her hardest to not jostle her daughter too much. “Shh it’s ok Lil. I’ve got you. Go back to sleep love,” she whispered. Lily’s head tucked into her neck as she held her close. Her legs hung limply at Kara’s hips. She closed and locked the car before heading inside with Alex. 

 

Alex led her upstairs to Maya’s room. Kara went to lay Lily down but she clung to Kara’s neck. “Nuh uh,” she whined. 

 

“Shh it’s ok. We can snuggle for a bit.” Alex laid Alexis down on Maya’s bed, clicked on the baby monitor, and they headed back downstairs. 

 

Kara held Lily close as she leaned against the kitchen counter. Maya was being cute coloring at the table while Lena and Maggie talked and set food out. Lily whined against her neck as she adjusted her hold under her butt. Alex came over and rubbed Lily’s back lightly. 

 

“Do you wanna go snuggle on the couch with me, bug?” 

 

Lily pulled her head out of Kara’s neck and reached over for Alex. Kara handed her over to Alex easily and watched as her sister went over to the couch to cuddle with her daughter. A blanket was wrapped around Lily as she snuggled into Alex’s arms sleepily. 

 

Kara helped Lena and Maggie set out food to be cooked on the grill as well as the prepared stuff. “What’s been going on with you guys lately? I feel like we only ever get like ten minutes at swim class to talk,” Kara asked. 

 

“I know we’ve all been so busy. Things have been good. We saw Eliza last weekend, that was a blast. Maya’s been having a hard time sleeping through the night for whatever reason so we’ve been exhausted. She’s been waking up like every four hours and coming into our room. After two nights of constantly putting her back to bed we just let her stay in bed with us after the first time she woke up. We’ve both been pretty busy with work. How have you guys been?” 

 

Lena popped a carrot into her mouth before answering Maggie, “The girls schedules have been insane. Why does an 8 year old need to practice softball three nights a week? She’s 8! The swim is fine because it’s earlier in the morning so when they’re done we have a snack and take a nap. But softball is later at night, right before Lex’s bedtime. So she gets cranky by the end of practice. We’ve been passing off softball duties all week so one of us can stay home and put Lex to bed.” 

 

Kara hummed in agreement as she took a bite of a piece of pineapple, “She was so excited to find out she’s playing second base at the next game though. She’s been begging to play catch every night when I get home from work. Don’t get me wrong I’m so glad she’s found something she enjoys. But god is it a huge commitment for us.” 

 

Maggie laughed, “Oh I know. Alex is already talking about signing Maya up for kids soccer. She’s barely even doing more than a toddle and Alex wants her to kick a ball around. I’m sure our lives will be very similar to you guys in a few years.” 

 

A half hour later Alex was grilling up burgers and hot dogs while Kara supervised the kids in the pool. And by supervising, she was dramatically throwing the kids into the deep end (they had on floaties!). “Kara if my daughter swallows half the pool you’re in trouble,” Maggie called out. 

 

Lena raised an eyebrow in her direction, “That goes for our daughters too darling.” 

 

“They’re fine! Right girls?!” 

 

Lily dramatically coughed from the deep end of the pool. All the adults minus Kara started laughing. “If your mom makes me sleep on the couch I’m taking you with me Lily!” 

 

“Nuh uh! I’ll take your spot in the big bed!” 

 

“Oh is that so?” She started swimming over towards Lily who immediately started shrieking and trying to get away. “I’m gonna get you!” 

 

Kara let her swim around the pool once before catching her and hoisting her over her head. “I’ve got you now! Mwhahah!” 

 

“Mummy help!” 

 

Lena laughed from the side of the pool, “Sorry love, mummy isn’t going swimming right now.” 

 

“The food is almost done anyway. Why don’t you guys all come out of the pool?” 

 

“Aw do we have to Tia?” 

 

Maggie put her hands on her hips and looked over at Lily, “Come on squirt you know you’re starving. I’ll help you fill your plate up.” 

 

Kara set her on the side of the pool and then got Maya and Alexis out as well. She set both little girls in front of a lounge chair and took off their floaties. Alexis fussed when Kara took her floaties off and pointed to the pool, “Swimmy mama.” 

 

“After we eat dinner you can go back in the pool baby girl. You’ve gotta fill your belly first.” 

 

Maya happily accepted the towel being wrapped around her and toddled over to Maggie who scooped her up. Alexis tried to pull away from her whining. “Someone still sounds tired,” Kara said while tugging Alexis closer to her.

 

“Nuh uh!” 

 

“Uh huh. Come on let’s go get some food and then you can go swimming again.” She scooped up Alexis and made her way over to the table where food was spread out. The girls really didn’t eat that much so Kara put a few strawberries on a plate with some watermelon, a hot dog, and a few chips. She sat down at the table with Alexis on her lap and cut up her hot dog. The little girl whined and squirmed in her lap. 

 

Lena set a plate of food down in front of her as she settled in with Lily next to her. “Thanks babe.” 

 

“Of course, love. Lex try to eat something and then you can go swimming again.” 

 

It took a little coaxing but they eventually got her to eat a few bites of hot dog and her fruit. Kara rubbed her back as she ate her own food as well. “Do you wanna go play on the slide?” Alexis nodded. Kara set her down and watched her toddle over to the little baby slide in the backyard. 

 

They continued eating and talking for a few minutes. “Did everything get taken care of at L-Corp today Lena?” Alex asked. It had been all over the news that someone had hacked into their mainframe. 

 

“Yes, luckily we were able to trace it back to someone. The FBI is pretty confident they have the right person but they’re still going to investigate.” 

 

“At least you were able to trace it. I’m sure it was a headache,” Alex commented. 

 

Lena hummed in agreement, “It was not my idea of fun on a Saturday morning that I’d rather spend with my girls. We had plans for the whole day. We had a ton of errands to run but most of them had to be pushed to tomorrow now. I didn’t want to send Kara all alone with the girls to take care of them.” 

 

Maggie raised her glass, “Amen to that. Last weekend there was a call during breakfast I had to take. It took hours to wrap up and get home. It really throws a wrench in your plans when you’ve got kids to schedule errands around too. We can’t just pick up and go to the grocery store anytime because Maya has to take a nap at noon.” 

 

“And you never know when someone is going to have a meltdown. Look at all of us talking about our kids. If you’d told me 10 years ago that this would be my life I would have never believed you.” 

 

Alex hummed, “And yet here we are. Wouldn’t change it for the world. Speaking of, Kara your daughter is being sneaky.”

 

Kara’s head whipped around to see Alexis toddling toward the edge of the pool. “Alexis Kieran Luthor-Danvers! Stop right there!” 

 

Her little eyes went wide as she turned to run back to the slide but it all happened in a second. Her foot tripped on her towel and she went careening back into the pool. Kara was out of the chair in a second racing toward her daughter. She dropped right into the pool and scooped Alexis up. Lena was right behind her kneeling at the edge. She passed Alexis up and then hoisted herself out of the water. 

 

Alexis coughed and cried as Lena patted her back and leaned her on her side to get any water out of her mouth that she could. Alex and Maggie were quick to run over next to them as well. “You’re ok Lex, you’re ok,” Lena tried to calm her down. 

 

“I’m gonna go grab my stethoscope to listen to her lungs. She should be ok, she wasn’t in long,” Alex said. She disappeared inside while Maggie wrapped a dry towel around Alexis. 

 

After a few minutes of crying Alex was finally able to check out her lungs and the rest of her. There wasn’t any trace of water in them thankfully and she didn’t seem to be hurt from the fall. But Alexis was scared beyond belief. Tears kept rolling down her cheeks no matter what anyone tried. Finally she reached out to Kara and whimpered, “Mama.” 

 

Lena passed her over quickly and Kara cradled her close. Alexis tugged at her bathing suit top as tears kept rolling down her cheeks. She’d stopped breastfeeding almost completely a few months ago. The only time Alexis was ever breastfed was when she was sick or really upset. She’d only been breastfed once in the past two months. “Ok, ok, love. Let’s go get comfy first. Mommy’s got you.” 

 

Kara carried her over by the firepit and settled into one of the chairs. “Babe, can you grab me a towel?” 

 

“Yea i’ll be right back,” Lena replied. 

 

Kara cradled Alexis in her arms as little hands tugged on her bikini top. “Ok love we’re getting there. It’s ok.” She pulled her top to the side and Alexis latched on right away. A little hand clutched to the tie of her suit around her neck. Kara rubbed her back lightly. “It’s ok. Mommy’s here. I’ve got you.” 

 

Lena appeared with a dry towel a second later. Kara leaned forward just enough for Lena to slip it behind her back and around her shoulders. She cradled Alexis’s head in her hand while her freehand rested on Kara’s shoulder. “She’s gonna give us a heart attack one of these days.” 

 

“Tell me about it,” Kara sighed. “I shouldn’t have let her go play on the slide. It’s my fault.” 

 

Lena squeezed her shoulder lightly, “It was an accident. She knows not to go by the pool without one of us. We’ll be more careful next time she’s around a pool.” 

 

Kara nodded as she gazed down into little green eyes. The tears finally stopped as her eyelids drooped. They both knew she’d be asleep in the next ten to fifteen minutes. Lily wandered over to them still looking scared. “Is Lex ok?” She wrapped an arm around Lena’s leg as she looked over at her little sister. 

 

“She’s ok. She’s just scared. That’s why we always tell you girls to be careful around the pool. If we hadn’t been watching she could have gotten really hurt.” 

 

Lily nodded and held tighter to her leg. Kara reached over and stroked her cheek, “She’s alright love. Go ahead and finish dinner ok? I think Tia and Aunt Alex might make smores later.” 

 

Kara snuggled with Alexis for another half hour in the chair after she was done eating and had fallen asleep. She was content to just hold her daughter close for the foreseeable future. Eventually everyone else joined her and Alex lit the bonfire. Maggie set up their outdoor screen and put a movie on for the girls. Lena settled in the chair next to her and Kara laced their fingers together. 

 

“These girls are going to be the death of us,” she whispered. 

 

Lena laughed lightly, “I couldn’t agree more love.” 

 

“But I wouldn’t have it any other way.” 

 

Lena hummed in agreement, “I wouldn’t give them up for anything.” 

 

“Me either.” 

 

They snuggled while the girls watched a movie. Alexis woke up and they managed to get her to eat a smore. With some enticing they managed to get her to put some pajamas on and snuggle with them. She stuck close to them the rest of the night but they weren't complaining. 

 

Lily gravitated to them as the sun set. They wrapped blankets around the girls and cuddled them close as they talked with Alex and Maggie about plans for next week. 

 

"We're planning on coming to Lily's game next week if that's ok," Maggie said. 

 

"Of course, we'll save you guys a seat," Lena replied. 

 

"Maybe we can all grab dinner after or something." 

 

Kara nodded, "It's an earlier game so we should have time. If we need to Maya and Alexis can always go down if it gets late." 

 

"Yea they can sleep anywhere. How's the little one doing?" Alex asked. 

 

Kara kissed Alexis's head where she was snuggled under her chin again. "She's ok. I think she's just scared." 

 

"I bet. But luckily we were all right there. And maybe we can bring it up at swim class and see if they can teach her how to float without her wings. Just in case." 

 

Kara nodded and Lena gave her hand a squeeze. "She's ok love." 

 

"I know. It's just scary." 

 

"I know. But hopefully she learned her lesson." 

 

Kara hummed and rubbed Alexis's back. She would be lost without her girls. Their goodbyes were quiet as they loaded up the car and headed home an hour later with promises to see their sisters next week. It was always eventful with the Luthor-Danvers family.

34. Road Trippin'

Summary for the Chapter:

“I never ever thought you’d be a dog person. I’m glad you are, don’t get me wrong. You’ve gone soft since we got married,” Kara teased.

Lena swatted her arm, “Oh shush. If I've gone soft it’s because my wife is a marshmallow.”

“Well that explains why you like eating me so much.”

A red blush colored Lena’s cheeks as Kara laughed. She clicked on the auto-pilot function when they got further away from the city. “So, bets on how long before the girls ask for something?”

Green eyes met blue, “Oh less than ten minutes. I guarantee it.”

Kara chuckled, “I think they’ll hold out for 20.”

“What are the stakes of the bet Mrs. Luthor-Danvers?” Lena asked with a raised brow.

“Hmm… winner gets to top for a week?”

Lena’s eyebrow lifted further, “Oh you are SO on. Get ready to be on your back for awhile darling.”
