Lily - 9 yrs old, Alexis- 2.5 yrs

July 2nd, 2029

10:05am

Kara loaded the three suitcases into the trunk of the car followed by backpacks, a cooler, and a tote bag of god knows what in it. In the backseat with the girls carseats were pillows, stuffed animals, blankets, and snacks. Lily came running out of the house with Lena and Alexis hot on her heels. “Darling don’t run please. Falling would not be fun for our vacation,” her wife called out.

Kara scooped her up as soon as she got close. “Yea bug, you don’t want to start off vacation with a scrape or a broken bone. That wouldn’t be fun.” She pressed a kiss to Lily’s forehead and set her back on her feet. “Did you go potty? We’re gonna be in the car for a long time.”

“Yep! Lex and I both went potty. We’re ready to go!”

Kara laughed, “Ok hop in the car and buckle up. Let’s get this show on the road.”

Lily climbed into her booster seat and clicked her seatbelt in. Lena appeared on the other side of the car with Alexis and strapped her in. They both gave a tug on their respective daughter’s seatbelts. Kara handed Lily a pair of headphones and her stuffed unicorn to hold. Lena was settling Lex’s stuffed bunny in her arms on the other side of the car.

“Krypto,” Kara whistled. He came bounding out of the house and hopped into the car, settling between the girls' seats comfortably.

They met back at the trunk after closing the girls’ doors. Kara glanced at their pile of stuff in the trunk, “Are we forgetting anything babe?”

Lena’s gaze swept over their belongings and she shrugged, “If we are we can just buy it when we get there.”

“Just because we can, doesn’t mean we should,” Kara retorted. She closed the trunk and wrapped her arms around her wife’s waist. “What did we get ourselves into? Over 8 ½ hours in the car with the girls…”

“I believe you said, ‘it’s camping babe! The girls will love it!’ So really this is your fault.”

Lena’s arms settled around her neck. Kara kissed her nose, “Don’t even act like you aren’t excited. It’s our first big family trip with the girls. I’m sure they’re gonna hate the car but we’ll get through it. And worst case scenario I can always fly the girls to Alex and Maggie and come back to get the car.”

“Ah ah ah, no. We are road tripping this as a family. No cheating with powers. The girls are so excited to play car games and have snacks. Maybe it won’t be a terrible experience.”

Kara snorted, “That’s because someone won't let them eat in the car ever.”

Lena’s eyebrow lifted as she pressed a kiss to Kara’s lips, “You’re welcome for giving the girls something to look forward to in the car.”

Kara gave her a squeeze, “Come on co-pilot, let’s get this show on the road. If we leave now we can be there around dinner time.”

Lena hopped into the passenger seat while Kara took the driver spot. A quick check of the mirrors first and then Kara pulled out onto the road. Lena plugged in their gps and then turned on a movie for the girls.

Kara couldn’t help but smile seeing her girls in the backseat happily watching their movie. She reached over and laced her fingers with her wife’s and gave a little squeeze. “Did you ever picture this in your future?”

Lena chuckled, “Road tripping over 8 hours with you and our daughters? I kind of figured when we said ‘I do’ that this would eventually happen.”

Kara gave her hand another squeeze as she pulled onto the freeway, “And when we were just friends? Would you have road tripped with me?”

Lena’s head tilted slightly before answering, “Darling I was so hopelessly in love with you I would have gone to Antarctica if you’d asked me to.”

“Awww babe, that’s so sweet.” Kara smiled over at her wife.

“But if you’d told me ten years ago I’d be in a Tesla with you, our two girls, and our dog; heading to camp at the Grand Canyon… I would have laughed so hard. That was never even an option I thought would be available to me. I never thought I’d have a life like this. One where I wake up so happy and so in love. And it’s all because of you.”

Kara pulled their joined hands over and kissed Lena’s hand. “It’s not just me. We created this life together. You’re just as much responsible for the love and happiness we have. I couldn’t have asked for a better partner to go through life with.”

Lena gave her hand a squeeze, “I couldn’t imagine this life without you either darling.” Krypto’s head appeared between them on the center console. “How are you doing buddy? Who’s a good boy?” Lena cooed and gave his head a scratch.

“I never ever thought you’d be a dog person. I’m glad you are, don’t get me wrong. You’ve gone soft since we got married,” Kara teased.

Lena swatted her arm, “Oh shush. If I've gone soft it’s because my wife is a marshmallow.”

“Well that explains why you like eating me so much.”

A red blush colored Lena’s cheeks as Kara laughed. She clicked on the auto-pilot function when they got further away from the city. “So, bets on how long before the girls ask for something?”

Green eyes met blue, “Oh less than ten minutes. I guarantee it.”

Kara chuckled, “I think they’ll hold out for 20.”

“What are the stakes of the bet Mrs. Luthor-Danvers?” Lena asked with a raised brow.

“Hmm… winner gets to top for a week?”

Lena’s eyebrow lifted further, “Oh you are SO on. Get ready to be on your back for awhile darling.”

A blush rushed up Kara’s neck, “Seeming pretty confident there babe. As I recall, you lost our last bet and spent two weeks on the bottom.”

“Yes, well, the girls won’t fail me. Neither have had anything to eat since breakfast and they’re your daughters. I’m sure someone will want food within the next ten minutes.”

“Game on babe. Start the timer. I’ve been dying to get you on your back for awhile.”

Lena’s thumb rubbed her hand softly, “Kar, if you’ve been bored you should have said something. I know we tease but I’m more than happy to switch things up with you.”

Kara gave her hand a squeeze, “Babe I’m not bored. Trust me any time we get alone is amazing. But I also know what you prefer and I don’t mind being on the bottom. You’re my wife, I want you to be happy too. I’ve pretty much always been a bottom with my past partners so it’s not like I hate it or anything. It’s just a nice change sometimes.”

Lena hummed, “I wouldn’t mind if we switched it up sometimes. I know it’s been awhile. I’m sorry darling, I should have noticed earlier.”

“Babe, it’s fine honestly. As long as you aren’t faking anything, we’re good.”

Lena scoffed, “I couldn’t fake it with you if I tried love.”

Kara laughed and pressed a kiss to the back of her hand, “Glad to hear it.”

“Mumma, can I have a drink?”

Lena smirked as Kara sighed, “Of course bug. Do you want some juice?”

“Uh huh,” came the little voice from the backseat.

“Well I guess I lost.”

Lena dug around in the bag she’d put by her feet and grabbed out a sippy cup. She passed it back to Lily with a smile. Carefully she leaned over and kissed Kara’s cheek, “But really you didn’t lose anything babe. What I’ve got in store for you… you’re very much a winner.”

Kara blushed and focused her eyes back on the road as she cleared her throat. It was going to be a long 8 hours.

1:30pm

“Mommy my belly hurts,” Lily whined.

Kara looked back at her daughter in the mirror, “Do you have to go potty?”

“No,” she whined with her arms wrapping around her stomach.

Lena turned and reached back to feel Lily’s forehead. “You don’t have a fever. Kar, why don’t we pull off and let her try to go to the bathroom. Then we can stretch our legs too.”

“Alright,” Kara said while maneuvering them over to the slower lanes and taking it off auto-pilot. Lily whined behind her seat. “Maybe you should get her a bag just in case she throws up.”

“Good thinking,” Lena responded. She quickly got a bag and passed it back to Lily. Lena stayed turned in her seat with a hand rubbing Lily’s knee. A minute later Kara pulled off into a rest area and parked the car.

She climbed out and unbuckled Lily who immediately held out her arms to be carried. Kara scooped her up and rubbed her back. “How about we try to go potty?” Lily buried her face in her neck with a whine. “I’ll be right back babe. We’re gonna go to the bathroom.”

“Alright love. I’ll wait until you get back to get Lex and Krypto out.”

Kara nodded before heading into the direction of the bathroom. Lily snuggled into her arms as she walked up the path. A few people were discussing what snacks they wanted from the vending machine. She made her way to the bathroom, “Baby do you want me to go in with you? Or are you ok on your own?”

Lily held onto her tighter, “With me.”

Kara kissed her head and went into the larger stall. She situated Lily and crouched down next to her, gently stroking her cheek. “If you don’t feel better in a little bit we can give you some medicine, ok?”

Lily nodded as her arms wrapped around her belly again. They waited a few minutes without anything happening. Kara scooped her back up once they were out of the bathroom. Lily snuggled into her neck again.

“Any luck?” Lena asked as they approached the car again.

“Nope. I’m gonna get her a tums,” she said as she set Lily back in her booster seat.

Lena went over to Lily’s side of the car to quietly talk to her. Kara dug around in one of their bags looking for the tums. A quick hearing check let her know that Alexis was still asleep in her carseat. Krypto was whining between the girls, wanting to run around outside. Her hand passed over half a pharmacy in their bag before she finally found the tums. “Babe, how much medicine did you pack? We’re only gonna be gone for a week and a half.” Kara shook out a tums and gave it to Lily.

Lena huffed, “Just the basics. Kids motrin, benadryl, tums, cold medicine, allergy meds, melatonin, and whatever is in the first aid kit.”

Kara chuckled while shaking her head. “I guess we’ll be prepared for anything.”

“Exactly. Just remember who has all the meds when Alex and or Maggie gets hurt.”

Lily’s little arms reached out to Lena who scooped her up right away. “Mummy, will you sit by me?”

“Of course sweetheart. Kar why don’t you take Krypto out for a little bit and I’ll make sure the girls are settled.”

“Alright,” she responded. Kara let Krypto climb out as she attached his leash. The second his paws hit the pavement he was off to the races. Kara had to grip onto the leash as he pulled her toward the grass. “Ok calm down buddy. You can sniff for a little bit geesh.” He tugged her from tree to tree as he sniffed everything he could find. They made a few laps around the grass so he could stretch his legs and pee.

When he tried to roll in the grass she gave his leash a tug. “No buddy. You are not getting all full of whatever is in this grass before getting back into the car.” He whined but padded back towards the car. She got out a collapsible dog bowl from the trunk and put some water in it that he immediately started lapping up. Kara grabbed a treat from their dog bag and gave it to Krypto when he was done drinking. He hopped into the car again but at Lena’s feet this time as she was sitting between the girls.

Kara climbed back into the car and settled into the driver’s seat. Lily was leaning against Lena as much as she could. Lena was running her fingers through her hair gently as she hummed softly to her.

4:02pm

Alexis started sniffling in the backseat. Lena’s head was resting against Lily’s as they were both asleep. Kara pulled off the freeway and into another rest area. She quickly parked, climbed out, and unbuckled Alexis. Her little girl whimpered as she settled her on her hip.

“Hey what’s wrong baby girl?”

Alexis rubbed her eyes, she’d just woken up from a long nap. “Firsty,” she whined. Kara went up to the front seat and dug around for another sippy cup. It only took a second to find that her wife had packed a few sippy cups along with some snacks. She grabbed out the Frozen cup and handed it to her daughter. Alexis immediately started drinking as she leaned against Kara.

Kara pulled out a few snacks as well knowing her daughter was going to be hungry after her drink. She pulled out some of the weird yogurt drops Alexis liked as well as some puff snacks. She grabbed a granola bar for herself and glanced back at her wife and daughter. Lena wasn’t breathing as deeply as normal so she was probably going to wake up soon. Lily on the other hand was out cold.

“Do you wanna watch a movie when we get back in the car?” Alexis nodded as she kept drinking her juice. Kara started to walk around the path with Alexis on her hip just to stretch her legs. “Do you want to walk around for a little bit?” Lex snuggled against her more. “Ok cuddle bug. You don’t have to walk around if you don’t want to.”

They made a few laps around the park while Alexis finished her juice. Kara set her down on her feet when she handed over her sippy cup. Alexis held onto her hand as they walked back toward the car. Her little toddle was adorable and Kara adored it. Lena was awake and was rummaging around in their cooler in the trunk when the duo approached. Kara put Alexis back into her car seat with her little container of yogurt snacks.

Lena rounded the car and handed her a water bottle. “Do you want me to drive for awhile Kar?”

Kara yawned, “Sure. We’re over halfway now at least. I was trying to get as far as possible before stopping again but Lex woke up and was about to cry. I didn’t want her to wake Lily up, just in case she still feels sick.”

“Hopefully she stays asleep for a while. I hope she’s not getting sick.”

Kara hummed in agreement, “It’s probably all the excitement paired with eating snacks that we normally don’t let her have. I’m sure she’ll be ok when we get there.”

“Yea that could be it. I’m sorry I fell asleep on you. It had to be a boring few hours with all of us asleep.”

Kara shrugged, “It’s ok. We’re on vacation and that means naps. I listened to a podcast for a little bit. It wasn’t a big deal.”

Lena’s arms wrapped around her waist as Kara’s slid around her neck. “I can’t wait for the girls to stay with Alex and Maggie for a night.”

“Mmm me either,” she agreed. She pressed a chaste kiss to her wife’s lips before pulling away. “Come on, let’s get on the road. I’m ready to be on vacation and not in this car.”

4:30pm

“Mommmm I’m bored,” Lily whined.

Kara sighed from the front seat, “Do you want to watch a movie?”

“No, we already watched three movies.”

“How about we play ‘I spy’?”

Lily huffed, “That’s boring too.”

Kara looked over to Lena who was smirking slightly. “Well how about a book?”

Lily seemed to think about it, “What books do we have?”

Kara silently cheered as she dug in her bag, “We have the new Dog Man book.”

“Oooh gimmie!”

With a laugh she passed the book back to her daughter. Lena reached over and gave her thigh a squeeze as they kept driving.

4:45pm

Alexis whined from the backseat, “Mumma, hungry.”

Kara turned to look at her youngest, “Do you want some applesauce?”

“Nuh uh,” she whined as her fists rubbed her eyes.

Kara dug around in their bag again to see what they had. “How about some cheese puffs?”

Alexis yawned, “Uh huh.”

Kara passed the little container back to her daughter. Of course they were organic and safe for kids at her wife’s request.

Lily looked up from her book, “Are we gonna be there soon?”

Lena sighed this time, “We’ve got about two hours left. It’s about… as long as Frozen.”

Lily groaned, “It’s so long.”

Kara agreed, “I know baby. But we’ll be there soon.”

6:54pm

The tesla pulled up next to two cabins, where another SUV was already parked with the trunk open. Alex’s back was to them as she got something out of the trunk. Lena parked the car next to her sister-in-law’s and Kara was hopping out almost immediately.

“Well it’s about time you guys got here,” Alex teased as she pulled Kara in for a hug.

“We had a stomach ache, cuddles, and incessantly asking ‘are we there yet?’ It’s lucky we even made it in one piece,” Kara whined.

 

Alex chuckled, “Sounds like your first family vacation is starting well. We had a few hiccups as well.”

“Well at least we weren’t alone in our suffering,” she replied. Kara moved to open the back door and scooped Alexis out of her car seat. On the other side of the car Lena was opening the door for Lily. Both girls instantly lit up at their surroundings. They tried to get the girls out of the city when they could but it was mostly to hotels, never a cabin like this.

“Aunt Alex!” Lily exclaimed as she ran over and hugged around Alex’s waist.

Alex’s hand came to rest on the back of her head, “Hi bug, how was the drive here? Are you ready for lots of fun?”

Lily nodded quickly, “The car was boring. Where’s Aunt Maggie and Maya?”

Alex smiled at the mention of her family, “They went inside to get a snack. Why don’t you and Lex go get a snack too?”

Lily nodded again as she released her hold on her aunt. She grabbed her little sister’s hand and dragged her in the direction of the cabin with the open door. Kara laughed as she shook her head, the girls were just like her and Lena.

The trunk popped and Kara got to work on getting all their luggage out of the car. Alex pulled a cooler from the trunk of her own car. “If you want we can take the girls tonight and then you can take Maya tomorrow?”

Lena sighed happily, “You have yourself a deal there.”

Kara laughed before turning to her sister, “Who would have thought she would ever want to take a vacation?”

Lena slapped her butt lightly, “Being a parent is a full time job. Plus, as I recall, you lost a bet in the car.”

A blush radiated down Kara’s neck as Alex laughed, “I don’t wanna know. Still my little sister. But we’ve got the girls taken care of tonight.”

Lena winked over at Alex, “We appreciate it. We’re happy to take Maya tomorrow. I swear to god there’s never a chance to have a half hour alone unless we get up early. But even then sometimes one of the girls is awake.”

Alex laughed, “At least your wife has super hearing. We’ve gotta rely on a bedroom door lock and a baby monitor.”

Kara flushed a darker red, “Ok, ok. Enough talk about our sex lives. Let’s get unpacked and go wear the kids out.”

Alex and Lena both laughed as she pulled their suitcases out and headed to the cabin. With a quick turn of the handle she stepped inside and dropped off their luggage. She made quick work of all their bags and the cooler. The cabin was cute to say the least. It had a homey feel to it. The walls were all wooden and the kitchen was beautiful. There were two bedrooms off the main living area. One had two twin beds in it, the other was the master suit. Kara was so looking forward to having time with their family and no interruptions.

Lena stepped in behind her, “Alex and Maggie suggested we go down to the water and grill for dinner. How does that sound to you?” Her fingers danced across Kara’s lower back which caused a shiver to run up her spine.

“Mmmm ok,” she agreed quickly. Without a second thought she unloaded their cooler with superspeed and pulled out a package of hot dogs and hamburgers to cook. Lena grabbed some snacks and put them on the counter before starting to dig through the girls luggage for bathing suits.

The girls raced in through the door, “Mommy we’re gonna go swimming!”

“I know bug. Let’s get you two into your swim suits and talk about rules.”

Lily groaned, “Why do we gotta have rules?! We’re on vacation!”

Lena handed LIly’s bathing suit to her and began undressing Alexis to put on her suit. “Rules keep you safe. They won’t stop you from having fun. You have to always be with an adult when you’re going to the lake. There’s lots of animals out here that could hurt you guys. And in the water we want you girls to have floaties on.”

“But I can swim!” Lily protested as she started stripping off her clothes.

Kara crossed her arms over her chest, “You can swim without the floaties if one of the adults is in the water with you. Remember what happened with Lex falling into the pool? We don’t want anything like that to happen again, ok? You probably won’t even need to wear them that much because we’ll all be with you.”

Lily frowned but nodded as she stepped into her suit. Alexis giggled and pointed at Ariel on her belly, “Mumma look! Ariel!”

Lena smiled and pressed a kiss to her forehead, “You’re so right baby. That’s Ariel! You’re so smart! How about we go swimming and have dinner now?” Both girls grinned and nodded fast.

Kara handed each girl a bag of snacks to carry as she loaded up their other food into a bag. She zipped into her own bathing suit and watched as Lena started to pack a bag with towels and stuff. “I’ll meet you down there in a few,” she said, pressing a kiss to Kara’s lips.

“Ok babe. Don’t be long, it’s your vacation too.”

The girls raced out the door with Kara hot on their heels. They headed toward the water where Kara could already see both her sister’s and Maya on the beach. Maggie was cleaning off the grill that had been placed a little ways away from where the blanket was in the sand. “Floaties!” Kara yelled as the girls dropped their snacks on the blanket and started to make a break for the water.

Alex laughed as she put a life jacket on Maya. “Girls, you two are going to give your mom a heart attack. Put on your floaties so we can go swim.”

Lily stuck her tongue out at her aunt but raced back to Kara and held out her arm for her floatie. Kara slid the band around her arm and then did the same with the other arm. Alexis was bouncing next to her sister in the sand waiting her turn. As soon as both floaties were on Lily’s arms she raced for the water and splashed right in. Kara shook her head as she scooped Alexis up. “What are we gonna do with your sister? I think she’s part fish.” She tickled the little girl's stomach causing an eruption of giggles.

With Maya’s life jacket on securely she ran over to her aunt and held her arms up. “Uppy pease Aunt Kara!” Kara laughed lightly as she squatted down to scoop up her niece. With a toddler on each hip she headed for the water.

“Take your time Al. I’ll keep an eye on the girls,” she called back to her sister.

She waded into the water where she could see Lily bobbing around. “Momma frow me!” Alexis squeaked from her arms.

“Me too!” Maya chimed in. Kara laughed as she carefully tossed Alexis into the water (not hard enough that her head went under) followed by Maya.

Lily quickly swam over, “Me too mommy! I wanna go far!” Kara lifted her daughter into her arms and tossed her away from the younger girls who were giggling away splashing around.

Kara slid into the water and scooped Alexis up to put her on her shoulders. “Mommy shark is gonna get you!” As she ‘swam’ past Maya she scooped her up and put her onto her back behind Alexis. The three of them moved towards Lily who was giggling like crazy.

“You can’t catch me! I’m super fast!” Lily started swimming away as fast as her little feet would take her.

Kara couldn’t help but laugh as she felt both Maya and Lex giggling and wiggling around. “Faster mommy!” Lex yelled. “Faster Auntie Kara!” Maya joined in.

Obviously she could catch Lily if she tried but then the game would be over. “Mummy help! The sharks are gonna get me!” Lily cried out as Lena came into view on the beach.

“Nobody can save you now little bug!” Kara called out as she closed in on her daughter. “Go baby sharks!” She lifted Lex off her shoulders and set her in front of herself. Then she moved Maya off her back to join Lex. The two toddlers started splashing after Lily.

All three adults on the beach were laughing at the game being played in the water. Lily swam toward the beach and ran up onto the sand, hiding behind Alex. “Save me from the sharks Aunt Alex!”

Being the awesome aunt/mom that Alex was, she lifted Lily up over her shoulder and ran towards the water with her. “We can out run the baby sharks if we swim fast!” She grabbed a kickboard as she ran past and splashed into the water.

“Please don’t drop my kid head first. It’ll make for a long vacation!” Kara teased.

Alex rolled her eyes, “Please, i’m more careful than you are. It’s lucky that I let you play with my kid in the water. Now hush i’ve gotta save this young child from the sharks!” Alexis and Maya were chasing after Alex and Lily but not really gaining any ground.

Kara laughed and watched as Alex adjusted Lily to sit on the kickboard while taking them into deeper water. She was obviously making sure both the little girls were ok even with their floaties/life jackets on. Alex swam out about a hundred feet as both girls swam after her.

Arms encircled her waist, drawing attention away from the kids and Alex. “You just keep surprising me. I thought it would take at least three sets of puppy dog pouts to get you into the lake,” Kara teased, squeezing her wife’s hands resting on her stomach. Lips pressed to her shoulder gently.

“My wife is in a bikini, abs on display, playing with our kids, soaking wet in the lake. I don’t know about you but that definitely screams that I need to join in.”

“Mmm,” Kara let her eyes close. “God I love you so much babe.”

Lena gave her a little squeeze and pulled them flush together. “I love you too darling. I’d love to tease you right now but I can only imagine we’re going to be attacked by the toddlers in the next few minutes.”

Kara sighed, “You’re probably right. I’ll have to wait for my consolation prize until tonight.”

Lena chuckled from behind her, “It’ll be well worth the wait, I promise.”

They watched their girls giggle and swim around the lake for a few minutes before Alexis and Lily spotted them. “We can do all the sharks now!” Lily yelled from where she was still in front of Alex.

Maya paddled her way over with Alexis in tow. “Auntie Kara, can you be my shark?”

Kara scooped her niece up and onto her back, “I would love to be your shark. Let’s go get your mama.” Alexis made her way over to Lena at the same time and was shifted to perch on her hip.

“Mumma shark too?”

“Let’s go get Lily and Aunt Alex,” Lena replied as she shifted Alexis onto her back like Kara was doing.

“Hey four against two isn’t fair!” Alex called from about a hundred feet away from them.

Kara scoffed, “We have toddlers. You’ve got a pretty smart 9 year old.”

“Fine, no cheating super mom,” she called back.

Kara winked over at her wife as they swam towards their daughter and sister.

~~~~~~~~~~~

Two hours later Kara climbed out of the water. She was exhausted even though she shouldn’t be. The girls were quite the handful, especially when Maya was added into the mix. Lena had gotten out about a half hour ago to switch with Maggie and let her get some time in the lake with the girls. Kara grabbed one of their towels and dried off. She wrapped the towel around her shoulders as she made her way over to her wife who was flipping burgers on a grill (a sight she would always find funny). Her chin rested on Lena’s warm shoulder. “I could use a nap right now,” she yawned.

Lena laughed, “And you’re the one who gets energized by the sun. I hope the girls go down easy tonight for Alex and Maggie.”

Kara wrapped her arms around Lena’s waist, effectively pulling her into the towel with her. “I’m sure they will. We’ll get them fed, showered, put into pj’s, and then ship them next door. Honestly we’ll probably pass out as soon as they’re gone.”

Honestly it was true, they had both been busy with the girls schedules and their own work lately. This was the first time they had off in weeks. Kara sighed, “But I miss you.”

Lena turned in her arms and pressed a kiss to her cheek, “I miss you too baby. We can make time for us this trip. You’ve got superspeed after all.”

“Mmm but I really miss making sleepy soft love to my wife.”

Lena visibly shivered as she slipped an arm around her neck to lean closer. Kara closed the distance between them to press a soft kiss to her lips. Her arms tightened around her wife’s waist, pulling their bodies together. “Mmmm I think we can make time for some sleepy sex tonight or tomorrow.”

Kara sighed against her lips, “We should take a vacation just the two of us next time. Leave the girls with our moms. The three of them could handle Lex and Lily.”

Lena hummed in agreement, “Even just a long weekend together. We don’t even have to leave home. We can just take the girls to our moms. It would give us uninterrupted time together.”

“That sounds amazing. But maybe we can get a few nights here alone. If we rotate with Alex and Maggie it’ll give us all some much needed alone time.”

“That sounds like a wonderful plan. As long as nobody gets hurt, sick, or wants to cuddle.”

Kara groaned, “Don’t jinx it!”

Lena laughed as she turned back around and took the burgers off the grill. “Come on darling. Help me get the food set up for everyone.”

With a sigh Kara let her arms drop from around her wife’s waist and moved to tie the towel around her own hips. Then she moved to get paper plates set up with buns for everyone. “Guys food’s ready! Come get it!”

She could hear Alex and Maggie trying to catch the toddlers as Lily ran up the sand toward them. “I’m hungry!”

Kara wrapped a towel around her, “I’m sure you are. Go sit on the blanket and I’ll bring you some food honey.” Alexis raced outta the water as soon as Alex set her onto her feet. She ran over to Kara who scooped her up. “You’re a wet little squirt! We gotta wrap you up like a burrito!” She made quick work of wrapping her baby girl in a towel and setting her next to Lily on the blanket.

A few minutes later each girl was settled with half a hamburger, some fruit, and some veggies on their plates. Somehow Lena had gotten their girls to like drinking water, Kara had no idea how, but they were. Kara put some food on her own plate and sat next to the girls. Lily leaned into her side as she ate her food. “Today’s been the best day ever mom.”

Kara pressed a kiss to her head, “I’m so glad you girls are having fun. Did you have fun too Alexis?”

“Uh huh,” she yawned. Lena sat next to them and Alexis immediately crawled into her lap. Kara smiled as her wife snuggled their daughter closer.

“Do you girls want to go have a sleepover with Aunt Alex and Maggie tonight?”

Lily nodded, “Maya has a bunk bed in her cabin. Can we sleep there?”

Kara rubbed her back lightly, “I think that would probably be ok.”

Alexis snuggled into Lena as her little eyes closed. Kara laughed and held Lily closer. It was going to be an early night hopefully.

Notes for the Chapter:

Next chapter will be Kara and Lena getting some much needed alone time together ;)

35. Alone time ;)

Summary for the Chapter:

Lena bit her lip in the way that always made Kara’s heart stutter in her chest. “Are you sure?”

“Babe, you’re my favorite snack,” she said with a grin. Lena rolled her eyes but laughed nonetheless.

“I married a dork.”

Kara gave her a squeeze, “But I’m your dork. Don’t act like you’d trade me for someone else.”

Lena cupped her cheek and pressed a soft kiss to her lips, “Never. You’re it, you always were.”

Notes for the Chapter:

Kara knelt on the floor in front of the girl’s luggage with Krypto at her side. She pulled out matching plaid pajamas for the girls and held out a little pair of pants. “Step in Lex.” A little hand came to rest on her shoulder as a small foot made its way into a leg hole. Another foot followed and Kara guided the pants up her daughter’s short legs. “You have little chicken legs just like your mumma.” 

Alexis giggled and stuck hands under her armpits, “Bock bock!” Lily came into the room fresh out of the shower with a towel on her head. She rolled her eyes at her little sister’s antics. Kara chuckled and helped her daughter put the top on and button it. “You two have to be on your best behavior for Aunt Alex and Tia, ok?” 

Both heads nodded at her. She guided a brush through her daughter’s wet hair and watched as Lily put on her own pajamas without needing any help. The girls were getting so big, it felt like just yesterday that Alexis was born. Lily was already getting tall for her age, no doubt she was taking after Kara in terms of height. Alexis didn’t seem like she was going to be as lucky as her sister in the vertical department. Her fingers quickly weaved the thin hair into a french braid. “If you girls get scared tonight just ask Aunt Alex or Tia to call us, ok?” 

Lily nodded, “We’ll be fine mommy. Right Lex?” 

Alexis nodded, “Big girls mommy.” 

“Silly me, how could I forget how big you two are getting?” Kara pressed a kiss to Alexis’s head. “Make sure you guys have your stuffies and blankets.” 

Both girls grabbed their respective blankets and favorite stuffed animals. She led them out of the bedroom and back into the main living area where Lena was nursing a cup of tea. “Are you two ready for your sleepover? I heard Aunt Alex talking about a movie and hot chocolate.” 

Alexis’s eyes grew wide, “Hot chocolate!?!” 

Lena laughed and scooped up their youngest daughter to press a kiss to her cheek. “Only if you’re really good for your aunts. You two have to go to bed when they say without a fuss, ok?” 

Lily and Alexis both nodded. There was a knock on the door and then Alex stepped through. “Hey where are my two favorite Luthor-Danvers girls?” 

Kara squatted down and gave Lily a quick squeeze, “Go give mum a hug and say goodnight. I love you.” 

“I love you too mommy,” Lily replied before running over to hug Lena’s legs. Kara reached over and took Alexis from her wife’s arms. 

“I love you lex. Be a good girl for Aunt Alex,” she punctuated with a kiss to her daughter’s cheek. Lena stepped up next to her as Alex took a hand of each of their daughters as Krypto trotted out after the two little humans he loved the most. 

“We’ll see you guys tomorrow morning,” Alex called over her shoulder with a wink. Kara followed them to the door, with a click it was shut and locked. Then she spun around to face her wife. Lena held a hand out to her that she gratefully crossed the room to take in her own. 

“Do you hear that darling?” 

“Hear what?” Kara asked, cocking her head to the side like Krypto often did.

“Exactly. It’s quiet.” Lena whispered. 

Kara laughed as she wrapped her free arm around Lena’s neck. “Should we fill the silence?” 

Lena’s arm slipped around her waist and tugged her closer. Their lips brushed against each other softly. Kara shivered as she pressed closer to her wife’s body. “I know I lost the bet. But I really miss taking my time with you.” 

“Forget about the bet, love. I just want to be with you.” In an instant Kara was drowning in the feel of her wife. Soft lips left a scorching trail down her neck that had her whimpering in mere seconds. The arm around her waist moved to grip her hip. “Let’s go to bed darling. Hop up.” 

Kara raised an eyebrow at her wife who responded the same. Lena tapped the outside of her thigh, “You heard me. Hop up. Legs around my waist.” 

Kara lifted one leg to wrap around her wife’s hip followed by the other. Her ankles locked behind Lena’s back as hands slid under her thighs. She used the tiniest amount of her powers to float ever so slightly, so that Lena would actually be able to move them. Her arms tightened around her neck as her fingers slipped into dark locks. It only took a second to connect their lips again. Lena sighed at the contact but continued moving them towards the bedroom. Her mouth trailed kisses down to her wife’s sharp jawline. “Kara I’m going to drop you if you keep doing that,” Lena panted. 

With a smirk her thighs tightened around lithe hips. Lena took a few steps toward the bedroom but stopped to press Kara’s back to the wall as lips moved down her neck. “We’re never going to make it Kar.” Kara’s teeth sunk into her neck lightly and her tongue moved to soothe the bite.
