38. A blast from the past

Summary for the Chapter:

Kara and Lena prepare for a birthday party and get a visit from someone unexpected.

Notes for the Chapter:

Thank you to everyone who has left a kudos or a comment, or just taken the time to read this little fic. It has been an absolute honor to bring this story to life. I hope you like this last little installment of our favorite family :)

June 1st, 2034

 

Kara yawned as she woke up. Today was going to be a great day, she was sure of it. Liam was turning 3 today and they were having quite the party for him. He expressed loudly that he needed a dino party. The backyard was decorated to look like something out of the Cretaceous period. Large boulders lined one side of the yard, tall fake trees dotted various spots, and there were dinosaurs. Lena commissioned someone to make realistic looking dinosaurs that the kids could sit on and take pictures with. Liam was going to absolutely lose his mind. They had dino nuggets, french fries, hot dogs, and hamburgers because those were Liam’s favorites. Everyone else was bringing a dish to pass consisting of pudding, fruit, veggies, ice cream, and salad. 

 

She stretched while tuning her hearing into each member of her family.The clock read 8am and the sun shone brightly through the curtains. Lily was snoring quietly in her room down the hall, the tv still on with the volume barely on. Alexis was awake and talking quietly to Krypto it sounded like. She could hear the softest sound of her petting him and the soft thump of his tail against her blankets. Her hearing stretched just a little further and honed in on the birthday boy. He was sound asleep and letting out little huffs of breath, probably face down in his pillow if the sound was any indication. Her lips tugged up into a smile, her life couldn’t be much more perfect. 

 

The bathroom door opened quietly and Lena came into view scrunching her hair with a towel. Kara sat up with a smile, “Morning.” 

 

“Morning love,” she replied while leaning over to press a kiss to her lips. Lena stood and padded to their closet where she started pulling out clothes. 

 

“Today is gonna be crazy.” 

 

“In the best way though. He’s so excited. He was up at 5 asking if it was dino time,” Lena said with a laugh. 

 

Kara chuckled along with her, “Of course he was. What’s on the agenda for this morning?” 

 

“I’m gonna make breakfast for the kids while you shower. The girls have softball from 10-11am and I thought you could take Liam with you so I can set up everything else. Everyone should be here around 5pm so that gives the girls enough time to come home, shower, eat, and maybe have a nap. The cake is ready to be frosted so I’m going to do that while you guys are gone. Fingers crossed it goes well. Then we should have the party and it’ll be a blast.” 

 

Kara climbed out of bed with a stretch. “And when something inevitably happens?” She crossed the room to join her wife in the closet where she pulled out a pair of Nike pro shorts, a sports bra, and a tank top. Lena lifted an eyebrow in her direction. 

 

“We’ll wing it, it’s what we’re best at.” Lena turned to face her wearing khaki shorts, a blue jean button up shirt, and a red bandana. All she was missing was the hat to make her the perfect female Dr. Alan Grant, Liam was going to love it. 

 

Kara couldn’t help but laugh, “God you’re the best mom ever. He’s going to absolutely lose it when he sees you.” 

 

“Just wait until he has both Dr. Grant and Dr. Sattler at his party. He’s going to be a happy little boy.” 

 

“Especially with all the dinosaur stuff he’s getting. You don’t think we overdid it do you?” She pulled out her outfit for later consisting of a darker blue tank top, a pink button up shirt, and khaki shorts. 

 

“No, I think we did just the right amount. We didn’t actually spend that much money on presents. He’s not getting more than the girls ever get on their birthdays. Now quit stalling and get in the shower. I’m gonna go start breakfast.” 

 

Kara rolled her eyes as she kissed Lena and headed to their bathroom. 20 minutes later she was stepping out of the bathroom with wet hair. The kids were all awake and downstairs it sounded like. She put her hair into a ponytail and tossed a flannel shirt over top of her tank top. It only took a second to find her family downstairs all seated at their breakfast bar with plates of waffles and pancakes. Kara pressed a kiss to Lily’s cheek, the back of Alexis’s head, and tilted Liam’s head back to kiss his forehead. “Happy birthday sweet boy.” 

 

“Fanks mama!” He said with waffles stuffed in his cheeks. Kara laughed and rounded the corner to grab a plate from her wife. Lena slid her a smoothie (that was loaded up with calories) along with a plate of pancakes and bacon. Kara kissed her cheek as she rested a hip against the counter. 

 

Lena’s gaze roamed up and down her body, causing her cheeks to pinken even all these years later. “Can I help you Mrs. Luthor-Danvers?” 

 

“I was just thinking that you would have melted my brain if we’d met when we were younger.” 

 

Kara laughed as she took a bite of her pancakes. “Ditto babe.” Lena shook her head with a laugh as she nursed a cup of coffee. Kara turned back to the kids sitting next to them. “The three of you are coming with me to the park for softball while mom finishes the coolest dinosaur cake.”

 

Liam giggled and stood up on his chair, “Dinos momma!” 

 

The five of them quickly finished up their breakfast with excited conversation between the kiddos. Together they worked to get all three kids ready for the day. Kara wrangled Liam into a pair of shorts that had dinosaurs on them and a little tank top with the House of El crest on it. It was one of his favorite combinations to wear. The girls appeared wearing shorts, tshirts, and sneakers. She slipped his little converse on and tied them up as Lena appeared with a backpack for her. 

 

“Water, sandwiches, snacks, and bandaids. If you need anything I’m only a phone call away.” Lena pressed a kiss to her cheek while she lifted Liam onto her hip. Kara slung the backpack over her shoulder while his little arms wrapped around her neck. 

 

“You act like I can’t control our children. Or at the very least keep track of them.” 

 

Lena chuckled, “I’m simply offering my wife assistance because I know our children can be a handful. Especially when one is wound up because he’s so excited for his party later. But I don’t doubt your ability to watch our children.” She directed her gaze to their daughters, “You two make sure you’re good for your mom. Or early bedtimes tonight.” Both girls nodded their understanding while Liam reached for her. “I know you’re so excited for your party later but you have to be on your best behavior ok? We’re gonna have so much fun later.” 

 

Liam giggled as Lena kissed his cheek soundly. “Ok guys, let’s get outta here. Your softball bags are already in the car,” Kara instructed. The girls raced out of the house and into the car. Kara leaned over and pressed a kiss to her wife’s lips. “I’ll see you later. Good luck with all the dino stuff.” 

 

“I don’t need luck, I’m a Luthor-Danvers.” Lena gave her butt a light slap that earned a squeak in response. 

 

Kara quickly but carefully got them to the park. Liam refused to be carried so he held onto her hand while the four of them made their way to the softball diamonds. Both girls immediately took their place with their teams. “Ok bud, it’s just you and me. How about we go to the playground?” 

 

Liam started hopping up and down, “The dinos?!” 

 

Kara laughed, “We can go play on the dinos.” This particular park had three dinosaur structures that doubled as playground equipment. It was Liam’s absolute favorite park to play at so he always tagged along when they had practice if he was allowed. Most of the time he went because both Lena and Kara tried to go to everything together. Sometimes there was a Supergirl emergency and she couldn’t but for the most part, they all ended up at the park. 

 

Liam took off in a sprint as soon as he saw the dinosaur structures come into view, “Race you!” His little legs carried him towards his favorite stegosaurus. Kara laughed again as she jogged behind him. 

 

Just as he was about to get to the playground she scooped him up from behind and tossed him into the air, “I gotcha!” He giggled and held onto her. She quickly climbed up the tail staircase until they were at the top. Then she let Liam down so he could play. There were all sorts of kids activities he could do up there. A little xylophone was in one wall, tic-tac-toe blocks in the other. The tongue was a slide while a little fireman’s pole was next to the head, probably supposed to look like bones sticking up from the ground. Liam ran to the slide, plopped onto his butt, and raced down it. Kara slid down the pole to watch as he ran back to the tail to scramble back up the structure. 

 

She was content to just watch Liam play as other families arrived for the girls practice. They’d become good friends with a few of the other families as they had other younger kids too. Lucy came into view with her little boy holding her hand. “Go on, you can go play with Liam,” Kara heard her say. At her approval, the boy ran up onto the structure. Lucy stopped next to her with her arms crossed over her chest, “Did you ever think we’d be the sports parents?” 

 

Kara laughed, “I never thought I’d be any kind of parent.” 

 

Lucy hummed, “Actually same. Although I guess we’re more likely than Lena or James to be here. That always cracks me up.” 

 

They made small talk as their little one’s played on the structure and their older one’s on the softball diamonds. Kara’s head tilted ever so slightly as she heard a soft pop in the distance. 

 

“What is it?” 

 

“It sounds like… a portal almost. Can you watch Liam? I’ll let Lena know he’s with you. I don’t think it’ll take long but just in case.” 

 

“Of course. Go on, we’re fine here.” 

 

Kara stepped closer to the play structure so she could see Liam, “Hey buddy I have to go somewhere really quick. Stay with Aunt Lucy ok?” 

 

“Kay mama!” 

 

With a nod to Lucy she quickly walked over to where the trees got thicker. She typed out a quick message to Lena telling her the kids were with Lucy and she was going to check on a weird noise. The reply was almost instantaneous telling her to be careful. Slipping her phone back into her pocket she weaved deeper into the forest. Leaves and twigs snapped under her feet as the hum of the portal grew lounder. She couldn’t see anything yet but she could tell she was getting closer. 

 

A quiet, “Shit!” caught her attention. She would know that voice anywhere, hell it was usually the first voice she heard in the morning and last before she went to bed. She rounded the trees and came to a small clearing where none other than her wife was standing brushing grass off her pants. 

 

“Lena?” 

 

Her wife in question turned to face her with a surprised look on her face. A rush of emotions crossed her features and Kara realized this was not her wife. It was her but… she was definitely younger. Her features carried a weight of sadness to them, like the weight of the world was on her shoulders. 

 

“Kara! I uh… I can explain?” 

 

“Are you ok? That looks like quite a drop.” She eyed the portal that was at least 3 feet off the ground. 

 

“Yea I’m alright. It didn’t feel the greatest but I’m ok. This is not where I planned for it to take me.” 

 

“I think you may mean that in more ways than one.” 

 

A perfectly shaped eyebrow rose in question.

 

Kara put her hands on her hips, “You can’t be more than 24 years old.” 

 

“I’m 25 actually. And I don’t see how my age is relevant here.” 

 

“You’re 25 so that makes it… 2019?” 

 

“Yes… last I checked it was 2019 for a few more months,” her arms crossed over her chest defiantly. 

 

“It’s not 2019 where you landed. It’s June of 2034.” 

 

Lena’s mouth wanted to drop open, she could see the slight movement before it turned into a clench. “And why should I believe that?” 

 

Kara shrugged, “You don’t have to. But I am going to need you to open the portal and go back. Because there are things you cannot see, they might change the future if you do.” 

 

A few emotions crossed Lena’s face. “And seeing you won’t already cause problems?” 

 

“I haven’t told you anything other than the year. Nothing really impactful there.” 

 

Lena’s mouth opened and then closed quickly. Her eyes moved up and down her body. Kara laughed slightly, “Ok stop checking me out, my wife wouldn’t appreciate that. You gotta go home, for real.” 

 

A blush raced up Lena’s neck, “I wasn’t checking you out.Wait.. your wife?” 

 

It was Kara’s turn to open and close her mouth. “Ok so I might need J’onn to wipe that from your memories.” 

 

“Well if he’s already going to… maybe I can pop in and see how I’m doi--.” 

 

“No!” 

 

Lena’s eyebrows shot up but then fell, “...am I dead? Do the assasination attempts finally work?” 

 

“No, no no no. You’re fine. I just don’t want to risk your future by seeing anything you shouldn’t.” 

 

As if the world was conspiring against her, Kara picked up on the sound of little feet racing towards her. With a groan she rubbed her temple, “Well you’re about to see things you probably shouldn’t. So we’re just going to have to wipe your memories. This is gonna be fantastic. Future you, is going to kill me. Do you have an image inducer on you?” 

 

“No I wasn’t carrying one on me when I left.” 

 

“Alright, fantastic, great. Welp, this is gonna be great.”  

 

Liam broke through the trees with Lucy hot on his heels. “Liam! Get back here!” 

 

“Mama!” He giggled as he raced to her. Kara scooped him up with an exaggerated groan. 

 

“You were supposed to stay with Aunt Lucy buddy. We talked about being good today.” She turned to Lucy who had her own son in her arms. “It’s alright Luce. I know you tried. I can take him from here. We’ve got a fun situation.” 

 

Lucy’s eyes glanced between the three of them, a laugh bubbled up from her lungs. “Oh this is great. You have fun with all this. Do you want me to take the girls home?” 

 

Kara thought about it for a second but then shook her head, “No it’s alright. I figure we’re going to have to wipe her memory anyway. Might as well say screw it at this point.” 

 

Lucy laughed again and waved as she headed back through the trees. Liam’s attention diverted to Lena and he cocked his head to the side exactly how she always did. He snuggled into Kara, almost sensing that she wasn’t the exact woman who had cuddled him this morning. Kara thanked the gods for that. She held up a finger to Lena, “I need to make a call. No going anywhere please.” With her freehand she dug out her phone and dialed her wife. 

 

“Everything ok darling?” Kara kept her eyes on the younger version of her wife. 

 

“Nothing life threatening or anything but… I need an image inducer.” 

 

Lena groaned on the other end of the line, “Are the kids with you?” 

 

“Liam is. He escaped from Lucy. And luckily he seems not to recognize our visitor. The girls will not be the same case.” 

 

“It’s one of us isn’t it?” 

 

“Yep, yes it is.” 

 

Lena groaned again, “I’m sending one with the nanobot drone. It should be there in thirty seconds.” 

 

Kara sighed in relief, “Thank you. You’re a lifesaver.” 

 

“Uh huh. Try not to do anything crazy please. I love you.” 

 

“Love you too babe. See you later.” 

 

She saw sadness and jealousy flash across the younger Lena’s face. Kara couldn’t help but bite her lip as she hung up. The hum of the drone wasn’t too far away. 

 

“So I’m going to need you to put on this image inducer when it arrives.” 

 

Lena’s arms tightened across her chest, “How do I know that’s what it actually is?” 

 

“I’ll use it on myself first to show you. I’m not trying to hurt you Lena. You have to trust me.” She adjusted Liam on her hip where he was currently snuggling into her neck. 

 

“Well I’m sorry if trusting you isn’t high on my list right now.” 

 

Kara’s heart dropped into her stomach, “Oh… oh… 2019. So I must have just left?” 

 

Lena nodded while directing her direction to the trees. “It’s just been… yea… I should just go home.” 

 

Kara couldn’t help herself as she reached out and gently placed her hand on Lena’s forearm. “Hey, I can only imagine what you’re going through. And if what you’ve told me is true, I know where you were trying to portal. For what it’s worth, I’d have loved to see you.” 

 

Lena snapped her gaze back to blue eyes, “You… you still see me now? In the future?” 

 

Kara couldn’t help but chuckle. “Since we’re going to wipe your memory anyway we might as well give you something to look forward to, right?” 

 

Lena’s arms uncrossed as Kara caught the image inducer from the drone. She quickly used it on herself to show Lena it was safe, then she turned it off and handed it over. Lena looked it over before clicking it on. She didn’t look much different; her hair was lightened significantly, her eye color changed to blue, and her facial features scrambled just slightly. Gone was her perfect jawline and eyebrows. Kara shook her head, “That’s so weird. Alright we have to head back.” 

 

Kara led them through the trees with Lena following closely behind her. “Liam this is mommy’s friend…” 

 

“Katie,” Lena called from behind her. 

 

“Yep. Mommy’s friend katie. Do you want to go play with the dinosaurs again?” 

 

He shrugged and sucked on his thumb. She heard Lena’s gasp from behind her, “Not real dinosaurs. Just the playground.” 

 

“Damn. That would be so cool.” 

 

“I know. Sometimes a pet turns into one but that’s about it.” She led them over to the softball diamond where Lily was playing shortstop. Liam snuggled further into her arms while Lena stepped up beside her to watch. 

 

“Which one are we watching?” 

 

“The one that looks just like me,” Kara laughed. “She’s playing shortstop.” 

 

It only took a few seconds for Lena to find Lily. She could see the math going on in her head and wanted to put it to rest. “Mon-el showed up when I got to Argo. She’s his. She just turned 14 last month. Her name is Lillian Alexandra.” 

 

Kara saw Lena freeze next to her, “Yep. I miss you just as much as you miss me in 2019.” Lily caught a line drive right to her. “Good catch lil!” Lily beamed over at her and waved before getting back into her squatted stance. 

 

“She’s beautiful Kar. Really.” 

 

Kara smiled, “Let’s go check on my little daredevil, make sure she’s not taking a softball to the face.” She led her over to the other diamond and she saw Lena scanning over the kids looking for another blonde haired girl. Kara pointed to first base where Alexis was almost a perfect mix of the two of their genetics. Her hair was a tad bit darker than Kara’s but her eyes were all Lena. 

 

“She doesn’t exactly look like Mon-El…” 

 

Kara laughed, “That’s because she’s not Mon-El’s. Lily and I come back to earth in 2025. I got married in 2026, and she’s born in 2027.” 

 

“That’s a lot to take in. I have a lot of questions.” 

 

Kara nodded with a smile, “I know you probably do. Let me see if I can get the most pressing ones. Yes you know her mom, yes she’s biologically both mine and my wife’s, and yes so is Liam.” 

 

Lena’s mouth opened and closed again before she settled on nodding. Her lips squeezed into a stiff line as Kara realized she must be feeling her heart shatter into a thousand pieces. She reached over and rested her hand on her arm again, “Hey, I promise your future is great. You are SO happy.” 

 

“I trust you I guess… I just… I’m feeling a lot of things.” 

 

Kara pulled her phone out and pulled up a picture of Lena holding Alexis chest to chest in the hospital. “I know your heart is probably breaking right now because you already miss me and now you’re finding out I’m married, not straight, and I have kids. But I can assure you, we’re going to see you right after this. And if you don’t believe me, you can see for yourself.” 

 

The girls both finished practice with little fanfare. The five of them piled into the car, Liam falling asleep almost as soon as he was put in his car seat. The girls didn’t really question their new guest because they were too excited about Liam’s party and seeing their family later. The drive home wasn’t too long and as soon as she’d put the car in park, both girls were racing inside. Kara got Liam out and settled him into her arms. “Don’t be nervous. They’re always this energetic.” 

 

Lena nodded while getting out and following her through the garage and into the house. Her eyes moved quickly around the space, probably looking for pictures of Kara’s life. Kara listened in and heard her wife upstairs getting Alexis into the shower. “I’m just gonna put him to bed really quick. Feel free to make yourself at home.” She quickly zipped upstairs and put Liam to bed. 

 

Her wife caught her in the hallway as she was leaving the girls bathroom, “Where’s our guest?” 

 

Kara rubbed her forehead, “Downstairs. Probably 10 seconds from a fucking nervous breakdown.” 

 

Lena laughed, “It’s me isn’t it?” 

 

“Yep. 2019. Fantastic time to try and convince you to put on an image inducer and come home with me. Oh and not to mention absolutely shatter your heart because my three children were there and I didn’t disclose who their other mother was.” 

 

Lena stepped closer to press their mouths together. Her hand gripped the back of Kara’s neck for a second while Kara’s hands moved to grip her hips. She sighed against her lips as their foreheads pressed together. “I forgot how sad you used to be.” 

 

Lena pressed another quick kiss to her lips, “It was all worth it. Now I’ve gotta finish up the cake. It’s almost done. How about we go give myself a heart attack?”

 

“I don’t really like that idea. But I should probably tell you that you’re my wife to stop the heart breaking that’s happening as I’m sure our family photos have been located.” 

 

Kara turned and padded back downstairs with Lena just behind her. She went to the living room where she heard Lena’s heartbeat while her wife went into the kitchen. Like she thought, the younger version of her wife was holding a picture of her holding the girls. Lena wasn’t in the picture because she was behind the camera, but she didn’t know that. 

 

“That was an amazing vacation. The car ride was absolutely horrendous with the girls but the actual trip was great. The best pictures are in the hallway though if you want to see who my wife is.” 

 

A blush rushed up Lena’s neck, “I wasn’t…” 

 

“She’s in the kitchen if you wanna say hi.” 

 

Lena cleared her throat and put down the picture, “I don’t know if I should…” 

 

On cue her wife called out to her, “Kar, can you let me know when Lily’s done showering? She wanted to help decorate the cupcakes.” 

 

“Yes dear,” she said with a roll of her eyes. 

 

Lena’s eyes had widened slightly in front of her. Kara couldn’t help but laugh a little, “I won’t even insult your intelligence, I know that you know who is in the other room.” 

 

“There’s no way. I have to be hallucinating.” 

 

“Babe,” Kara called out. 

 

Her Lena came through the doorway with a glass of water in hand. “For you, or me I guess. Take your time and take deep breaths.” She handed the glass of water to the younger version of herself as Kara slipped an arm around her waist. 

 

“Yea so, you can see why I wouldn’t want to really mess with the future. I would really like to not poof my wife or kids out of existence.” 

 

Lena’s hand rested on her stomach as she stretched up to kiss her cheek. “Speaking of your wife and kids, we have a party to get ready for later. So could you please have J’onn wipe my memory and get me back to 2019?” 

 

Kara nodded, “Yes, I just… I wanted to show you that you had something to look forward to.” 

 

Lena gave her a smile before turning to her younger self that was sipping the water looking shocked. “You have to wait a few years before this one comes back but I promise you it’s worth it.” Kara gave her a little squeeze. “Ok get outta here, we have to finish setting up for Liam’s party and I need your help.”

 

“Yes, of course.” Kara leaned down out of habit to press a soft kiss to her lips. Lena’s hand on her stomach scratched lightly before flattening to her ab’s. She pulled away slowly, her thumb fixing her smudged lipstick. She took a step back and slapped Kara’s butt as she walked back toward the kitchen.

 

The younger version of her choked on her water as Kara blushed. “Babe!” 

 

“What? Just appreciating what’s mine.” 

 

“Oh my god, can we please not give you a heart attack?”  

 

A roll of eyes was all the response she got. Kara turned back to her much younger wife. “Ok so J’onn and then back home.” A quick text to J’onn was sent and Kara led her out to their backyard. She changed back her appearance as they leaned against the deck railing. 

 

“That was a lot to take in,” came Lena’s quiet voice. 

 

Kara nodded, “I know. I just… I wanted you to know you have an amazing future. We’re so happy together. We have an amazing family and life. There’s nothing I would change, not even how long it takes us to figure our crap out.” 

 

Lena frowned slightly, “It feels so far away.” 

 

Kara stepped forward to cup her face in her hands and stroke her cheek, “I know it does. But I promise you, it’s worth every second. And once you’re back in my arms, I never let you go again.” She pressed her forehead to Lena’s and said screw it, J’onn was gonna wipe her memories anyway. Her lips brushed Lena’s ever so softly. She could hear her heart racing as Lena’s hands settled on her hips. “You are so loved, so wanted, and so perfect. You just have to wait for me to come back to you.” 

 

A tear rolled down Lena’s cheek and she tried to wipe it away subtly. Kara pressed a kiss to her forehead, “I love you so much. I promise you, forever is worth it.” Lena nodded as J’onn landed in the yard. She wiped Lena’s tears with her thumbs as the portal opened. They walked over and he pressed a hand to her temple gently. Kara watched as her eyes closed and she started to fall backwards. “Thank you J’onn.” 

 

Kara pulled her into a bridal carry and zipped into the portal. She padded across her wife’s old penthouse and settled her between her sheets. With a kiss to her forehead and the sheets tucked up around her, she stepped back through the portal as it closed. J’onn was already gone when she appeared back in her backyard. With a deep breath she went back inside, her arms immediately snaking around Lena’s waist. Her face buried in her neck where she could breathe in the familiar vanilla that had always reminded her of home. 

 

Lena’s hand rested on her arms that were wrapped around her middle. “You don’t know how much I needed that. I know my memories were wiped but I remember that day. I remember waking up from this amazing dream where I met our kids and you. It all makes sense now. But that dream is what stopped me from spiraling.” 

 

Kara squeezed her gently while she sniffled, “I’m so sorry I left for Argo.” 

 

Lena managed to turn in her arms, her own settling around her neck. “Hey, none of that. We said no more apologizing. I wouldn’t change anything that happened. It brought us here and nothing, and I mean nothing, would make me change what we have. You gave me hope Kar. Getting to see that I have a future, an amazing one, even though my mind was wiped, that meant and means everything. You could have sent me right back through but you didn’t.” 

 

“You looked so sad and heartbroken. I couldn’t.” 

 

Lena smiled a little sadly at her, “It was a rough time, I won’t lie about it. But also… have you seen yourself today babe? You look like you walked out of a lesbians wet dream. I’m sure I was heartbroken when I found out you were married.” 

 

“I wasn’t trying to make you sad!” 

 

Lena laughed lightly, “I know love. You gave me hope. And I can’t thank you enough for that. Now if a past version of you ever shows up… can I PLEASE be the one to say hello?” 

 

Kara laughed, “You’ll literally melt my brain, that’s not fair.” 

 

“Oh it so is. I bet you killed me wearing this. Have you seen your ass?” 

 

Kara couldn’t help the blush and eye roll. “Stoppppp. We have children upstairs.” 

 

“That we do. Speaking of, are they done with their showers?” 

 

Kara listened to the sound of Lily and Alexis both singing. “Nope. By the sound of it Lily almost is. I just heard the conditioner bottle close. Alexis is dancing around. Liam is still out cold.” 

 

“Alright. Whatta you say we get this cake finished?” 

 

Kara gave her another squeeze while leaning down to kiss her gently. “I love you so much.” 

 

“I love you too darling.” 

Years later it would be Kara’s favorite picture of them because of how much it showcased how happy they were. Kara dressed as Ellie, Lena as Dr. Grant, Liam as a velociraptor, and the girls as Dr. Hammond and Dr. Malcolm (fake broken leg and all). And to think… they reconnected because Lena was the CEO of Toddlers.



39. Bonus Epilogue

Summary for the Chapter:

Kara sniffled, “When did he get so big?” 

 

Lena gave her hand a squeeze, “I feel like it was yesterday that we were rocking him to sleep.” 

 

“I feel like it was just yesterday I was trying to bribe Lily to go into your classroom.” 

 

Lena laughed, “God I can’t believe that was over ten years ago. Who would have thought we’d be here?” 

Notes for the Chapter:

I woke up inspired! Here's a little something to feed your need for soft Supercorp Sunday :)

Lily - 16 

Alexis - 9

Liam- 5 

 

September 2036 

 

Four slices of bread, one tortilla wrap, one slice of cheese, one bag of shredded parmesan cheese, leftover grilled chicken, lettuce, peanut butter, jelly, turkey, mustard and caesar dressing. The peanut butter was lightly spread across one piece of bread followed by jelly on the other. Crusts were cut off and tossed to Krypto where he lay at her feet. Two quick cuts made the sandwich into little triangles. They were nestled into a dinosaur decorated kids bento box with care. Mustard was squirted and spread onto another piece of bread and covered with two pieces of turkey, one piece of lettuce, and a slice of cheese. That sandwich was cut in half and put into a pink bento box. The tortilla got a squeeze of caesar dressing, a handful of shredded cheese, lettuce, and the leftover chicken. She rolled it up like a burrito, cut it, and put it into a sandwich bag. That one made its way into a purple insulated lunch box. 

 

Next strawberries, blueberries, and bananas were cut into smaller pieces and divided between the first two bento box lunch boxes. A whole banana and a cup of strawberries made their way into the third. A handful of popcorn was put into the first lunch box, goldfish into the second, and a bag of doritos into the third. Sliced cucumbers and carrots were divided between the first two boxes and a snack bag went into the third. Lastly, mini oreos found their way into the first two boxes while the third got a snack bag with regular sized oreos. 

 

Juice boxes were added to the first two lunch boxes before she closed and zipped them up. The third got a little bottle of water and gatorade added to it before zipping it up. Then she took out three little sheets of paper and got to work. 

 

Liam! 

Have a good day at school!

I love you soooo much! 

❤️ Mommy 

_______________

Lex,

I hope you have a great day today!

Make lots of new friends and have fun!

I love you bug!  

❤️ Mommy 

________________

Lily,  

I can’t believe you’re a sophomore already! 

I’m so proud of you. I hope you have the best day! 

I love you

❤️ Mom 

 

Liam’s note was slipped into the front of his dinosaur lunch box, Alexis’s into her pink one, and Lily’s into her purple bag.

 

From the refrigerator she pulled out cream cheese, eggs, bacon, milk, orange juice, and an avocado. From the pantry she grabbed the Lucky Charms and a pack of bagels. Two bagels went into the toaster, a pan on the stove with bacon in it, cereal into a bowl, and two glasses filled with orange juice. She put the rest of the bacon, cereal, and the orange juice away. A quick zap of heat vision had the bacon sizzling away in the pan. The toaster popped up and she put the bagels on a plate and covered them with cream cheese. On one half she sprinkled cinnamon sugar, the other got everything but the bagel seasoning. The plate was set at the breakfast bar in front of a glass of orange juice. She set an apple next to it as well. Two cups were placed under the espresso maker as she clicked different settings for each. She flipped the bacon and then started another pan with the eggs. First were scrambled for Lily and Liam. Alexis hated eggs so she always had a bagel with fruit and bacon. She put four pieces of bread in the toaster and pushed it down. The eggs were done quickly, divided and put on two plates. She divided up the bacon as soon as it was done as well. One plate got two pieces of toast while the other got one. She put another four pieces of bread down into the toaster. The remaining eggs made their way into the pan to be sunny side up. Milk was poured into the bowl of cereal, and both cups were slid onto the counter from the espresso maker. To her own she added creamer and sugar. The toast popped up, she made quick work of buttering it before cutting and putting it on two plates. To one plate she added some smashed avocado, salt, pepper, and then put a fried egg on top of each piece of toast. The last two eggs made their way onto her own plate. 

 

Footsteps sounded loud on the stairs, it would have killed her ears if it had been years ago. But now her lips pulled up into a smile. Lily and Alexis dropped into their usual seats at the breakfast bar and immediately dug into their breakfast. Kara leaned back against the counter sipping her coffee as Liam raced down the stairs and over to her. She set her coffee down and scooped him up into her arms. “Are you hungry bubba?” 

 

He nodded his head quickly as his little hands cupped her cheeks and he pressed a messy kiss to her nose. She smiled and carried him over to his seat. “Well you better feed that little lion in your belly so it doesn’t try to come out at school. That wouldn’t be very helpful to make friends if you’ve got a lion roaring at them.” 

 

He giggled as she set him in his seat, immediately taking a bite of his toast. A hand slid across her back as Lena made her way into the kitchen. “Your son refused to put on his dino underwear and put up quite the fight,” she said as she got her own cup of coffee and took a sip. 

 

Kara ruffled Liam’s hair, “Were you giving mama a hard time?” She pressed kisses to his neck that made him giggle and drop his toast. 

 

“Nooooooo,” he giggled. 

 

Lena laughed lightly across from them. “He’s about 90% Zor-El and 10% Luthor.” 

 

Kara stood back up and made her way over to her wife. Her arms slid around her hips as she stepped close. “I like to think it’s more like 60/40.” 

 

“70/30,” she countered with a lifted eyebrow. 

 

Kara laughed as she leaned in for a kiss. Lena’s cup was set on the counter as her arms wound around Kara’s neck. Her fingers found their way to the base of Kara’s skull where they scratched gently. “Our baby is starting school,” she whispered against her wifes lips. 

 

Lena hummed in agreement, “I can’t believe how big they all got.” 

 

“You know we can hear you guys right?” Lily said with a smirk on her face. 

 

Kara rolled her eyes playfully, “Can you believe our babyyyy is driving herself to school today?” 

 

“Oh my god mom, are you going to cry?” 

 

Lena couldn’t help but laugh as Kara turned to look at Lily with a displeased look on her face. “That’s rude, you know. I only get emotional because I love you. There was a time I thought you were going to die from chemicals in the air, so I get to be emotional if I want to. Maybe we should drive you so that I can kiss your cheek before you go into school.” 

 

Lily looked horrified, “No! You guys said I could drive myself, no kissing at school needed. You can kiss me here and watch me drive away.” 

 

Lena laughed again as she slipped her arms around Kara’s waist. “Come on love, let’s eat breakfast before they have to leave.” 

 

Kara huffed as she dug into her breakfast with her wife by her side. Breakfast as a family wasn’t unusual because they always tried to eat together if they could. In a few weeks Lily wouldn’t be eating with them because swim practice started before school. She’d most likely eat breakfast with one or both of them while her siblings slept. What was different was the matching uniforms they were wearing. School had been a huge topic as the girls got older and Liam came along. Neither wanted boarding school, but public school made Lena a little nervous due to their last name. Lily and Alexis had gone to private school for a few years but they’d found a school they really loved. It focused on the individual strengths of each child and a hands-on approach to learning. Both of the girls were doing phenomenal and they knew Liam would love it as well. 

 

Once five plates made their way into the sink with three cups and two mugs, they headed to the front hall where Lily slipped on her backpack. Kara handed her lunch bag to her after she had her purse on her shoulder as well. Lena handed her keys over to her, “Text us when you get there please. Have a great first day sweetheart. I love you.” She pressed a kiss to Lily’s forehead as their arms closed around each other. 

 

Kara smiled as Lena stepped back so she could hug Lily herself. She kissed the top of her head, “I love you baby. Drive safe and have a great day.” 

 

“I love guys too, I'll text you when I get there.” 

 

Alexis gave her a quick hug and Liam whined until his older sister picked him up to give him a kiss. “Have a good first day buddy, ok? You can tell me all about it when you get home later.” 

 

He nodded quickly as she kissed his forehead and passed him over to Lena. Kara rested her hands on Alexis’s shoulders as the little family watched Lily get in her little car and drive off to school. 

 

The four of them made their way into the living room where they turned on Scooby-Doo. Alexis and Liam were quickly tuned into the show. Kara put their lunches into their backpacks and set their shoes out by the door for them. Lena’s arms encircled her waist when she was done. “Whatever are we going to do with a solid 6 hours without kids?” 

 

“Honest answer? Probably clean the house,” Kara replied.

 

Lena scoffed, “That’s so boring. We can clean the house later.” 

 

Kara laughed, “Well what do you suggest we do with all this time?” 

 

Lena wiggled her eyebrows, “We could soak in our giant bathtub that we never seem to have any time to use.” 

 

“Scandalous Mrs. Luthor-Danvers, but I like the idea.” 

 

The next hour passed quickly as they double checked Alexis and Liam had everything they needed for the day in their backpacks. Too soon they were all loading into the car and heading for the school. The weeks leading up to this moment had included a parent night for each of their kids. They’d taken Lily to tour the highschool, get her locker, and figure out where all her classrooms were. Another night they’d gotten to meet Alexis and Liam’s teachers, see their classrooms, and meet some of the other students. It had gone great on all three accounts. 

 

They got to school and piled out of the car together. Alexis put her backpack on and took her hand. Lena got Liam out and set him on her hip. Kara took his little dinosaur backpack in her freehand. The family made their way to Alexis’s classroom first. 

 

A handful of kids waited outside the door where the teacher was greeting each student by name. Kara gave her hand a squeeze as she squatted down to be at her height. “Have a great day today, bug. Make lots of friends and don’t forget, always be yourself. I love you.” 

 

Alexis’s arms wrapped around her neck in a tight hug, “I love you too mommy.” 

 

She stood and took Liam from Lena. Her wife was quick to scoop their daughter up, a move she didn’t do quite as often as she’d like because their girl was growing like a little weed and she was getting a little too heavy for Lena to carry. Little legs wrapped around her waist as Lena held under her butt. “Have a wonderful day, darling. I’ll see you after school. I love you.” 

 

“I love you too mummy.” 

 

Lena set her down and their hands found each other. Alexis ran to get in line behind her classmates. It only took a minute before she was being hugged by Ms. Rainer and going inside. Kara set Liam down so he could walk between them, each of their hands clasping one of his. His dinosaur backpack looked huge on his back, but it was adorable. “Wanna fly mumma!” He exclaimed while smiling up at Lena. 

 

“On three,” she said, briefly meeting Kara’s eyes. “One… two… three!” They swung him up off the ground a few inches between them. His giggles brought smiles to their faces. The one thing the kids didn’t have to wear matching was shoes, and he was rocking little blue converse. They made their way down the hall until they were finally at his classroom. Some kids were running around playing with other kids, but there was a handful that were clutching onto their parents crying. Liam seemed to take in everything going on around them. His grip on Kara’s hand tightened just slightly and she imagined he probably gripped Lena’s hand tighter too. Kara gave his hand a little squeeze as she kneeled down next to him. 

 

“Hey buddy, you’re gonna have so much fun today. Remember Miss Ashley said you guys are going to color and play with playdoh today. Maybe they’ll even have a dino for you to color.” Her free hand rested on his belly as she tried to draw his attention away from the crying kids. His big, blue eyes were wide as more kids started crying. “Hey, hey. It’s ok.” 

 

Lena squatted down next to him as well. He pulled his hands free from them to wrap one around Lena’s neck and grasp Kara’s shirt in the other. “Why are they cryin?” 

 

Lena rubbed his back, “They’re just scared. Sometimes kids are afraid to do new things, and that’s ok. But it’s also ok if you’re excited to go to school. There’s nothing to be afraid of. Alexis is just down the hall and you liked your classroom when we were here last week didn’t you?” 

 

He nodded but still looked scared. Kara kissed his cheek, “I bet a lot of these other kids don’t have an older brother or sister and are brand new to school. They might just be scared because they’ve never gotten to come here before. But you’ve been here lots of times to drop off and pick up Alexis. Do you wanna go inside and put your backpack away?” 

 

He nodded again, “You guys come too?” 

 

They both kissed his cheeks and stood, holding his hands again. The trio made their way inside the classroom and over to where a hook with his name was. They hung his backpack up and led him over to his seat. “Look buddy! There’s a dino right by your name!” Kara pointed to the stegosaurus sticker next to his nametag. Liam broke out a little smile at that. 

 

Lena ran her fingers through his hair softly. “I think you’re gonna have a great time today. I bet mommy even packed you a treat in your lunch.” 

 

Liam quickly looked up at her, “Did you pack me a treat?” 

 

Kara kneeled next to his chair and kissed his cheek, “Well of course you silly boy. I figured you were going to play so much today that you’d need some little oreos for lunch.” 

 

Liam smiled while wrapping his little arms around her neck. She felt him kiss her cheek, “Thanks mommy. I’ll be good today.” 

 

“I know you will, buddy.” 

 

He let go of her and made a ‘come here’ motion to Lena so she would squat down too. She did and he quickly hugged her and kissed her cheek. “Bye mummy. Love you.” 

 

“I love you too, sweetheart.” 

 

Their hands found each other when they stood back up. A little girl sat across from Liam looking a little scared. Her eyes were welled up with tears but it looked like she was fighting them. “Hi, I’m Liam. Do you wanna play with me?” 

 

The little girl smiled a little and nodded. “I’m Ellie.” 

 

Liam got up from his seat, pushed it in, and walked over to Ellie. He held his little hand out until Ellie took it and they headed off toward a table that had playdoh on it. Kara sniffled, “When did he get so big?” 

 

Lena gave her hand a squeeze, “I feel like it was yesterday that we were rocking him to sleep.” 

 

“I feel like it was just yesterday I was trying to bribe Lily to go into your classroom.” 

 

Lena laughed, “God I can’t believe that was over ten years ago. Who would have thought we’d be here?” 

 

“I definitely never thought I’d be married and have three kids, especially with my soulmate.” 

 

Lena squeezed her hand again, “Me either. But I’m so glad we found our way back to each other.” 

 

“Me too.” They watched for a minute as Liam got different colors out for himself and Ellie. Slowly the little girl started to warm up and play with him. He turned back and waved at them, signaling they could go home. 

 

They walked out hand in hand, kid free for the first time in months. “So… after we cry on the way home, we can still get naked together right?” 

 

Lena laughed, “Of course, love.” 

 

And that’s exactly what they did.



40. Christmas for five

Summary for the Chapter:

Lily finally turned her head ever so slightly until her face was half visible to talk. “She’s awake. Alexis wanted to snuggle and Liam woke up. They’re all snuggling upstairs.”

Lena ran her fingers through the blonde curls she adored so much, “And you didn’t want to join them?”

“Too many hands and feet in that cuddle pile. If they’re all together upstairs, that means I can cuddle with you all by myself.” 

Twinkling lights, hot chocolate, laughing with family. Those were just a small fraction of what made up their holiday gatherings. It wasn’t until Kara came into her life that she understood how wonderful holidays could be. Growing up holidays were itchy dresses and long nights in shoes that pinched her feet. It was parties with adults that wore fancy clothes and talked to her parents but never her. She had disappointing memories from holidays growing up. 

 

It was a shock to her system the first time she attended a Danvers Christmas extravaganza (because it totally was one). Everyone was so welcoming and happy. She spent an entire weekend surrounded by the cozy warmth of hot chocolate, snuggles while watching christmas movies, and sweets. And that wasn’t even her first Christmas dating Kara, that was simply their first Christmas as friends. Their first holiday as a couple had been mostly the same with the addition of sharing a bedroom and getting kisses whenever she wanted. 

 

The most wonderful change to the holiday festivities was seeing the magic of Christmas through the eyes of her kids. The first picture with Santa as a family of three sat on their mantle next to each one they took as more years passed. They progressed from the staged mall santa picture to ones that were more magical. She put down her steaming mug of tea to carefully picked up the most recent picture with Alexis eagerly looking up at ‘Santa’, who was really J’onn, her little curls falling down her back as her nightgown hung around her ankles. Lily was holding Liam on her lap as they both looked at the ball of light coming out of the snowglobe ‘Santa’ was holding in his hands. Some might think it was photoshopped but in reality she’d done a quick spell to make it illuminate brightly. 

 

A quiet creak of the stairs had her head lifting just in time to see Lily emerge. She set the photo back down and smiled at her daughter, “Good morning love. How did you sleep?” 

 

Lily yawned as she made her way over, her arms wrapping around her waist as her face found a warm spot against her rib cage to hide in. Lena cupped the back of her head with one hand and the other slid down between her shoulder blades. “How about some hot chocolate and snuggles?” Blonde curls bobbed in agreement silently. 

 

Lena led them to the kitchen and she quickly put a pot on the stove with milk in it. Lily kept her face firmly buried in her ribs and her own hand stayed put on her back. “I bet your brother and sister will be up soon. I’m surprised mom isn’t up yet though.” 

 

Lily finally turned her head ever so slightly until her face was half visible to talk. “She’s awake. Alexis wanted to snuggle and Liam woke up. They’re all snuggling upstairs.” 

 

Lena ran her fingers through the blonde curls she adored so much, “And you didn’t want to join them?” 

 

“Too many hands and feet in that cuddle pile. If they’re all together upstairs, that means I can cuddle with you all by myself.” 

 

A smile tugged up her lips and she leaned down to press a kiss to the top of her head. In a normally rare move (because Lily was just too heavy for her to carry), she lifted Lily onto the counter. She kept her a safe distance away from the stovetop but still close enough that she could stir the milk as it heated. Her arms wrapped around the little girl and she could feel her warm face tuck into her neck. “I love you so much. Merry Christmas darling.” 

 

“I love you too. Merry Christmas mummy,” Lily said quietly. The one relationship she had always worried about was her role as Lily’s stepmother. She didn’t have a great relationship with her own adoptive mother by any means and it only got worse as she got older. A deeper part of herself was concerned that one day Lily would push her away and wish her dad was in the picture. But that hadn’t happened yet and she refused to let it. Her first Christmas with Kara and Lily was something she would never forget. Seeing the joy and happiness in her second favorite pair of blue eyes as she thanked them for each present she opened. Kara had teared up when Lily excitedly brought over a toy for her to open and plopped right down in her lap. Now, five Christmases and two kids later, her life was full of smiles and giggles. 

 

It only took a few minutes before she added in the chocolate mix that Kara had perfected and the liquid was piping hot. She let go of Lily for a minute to take it off the heat and fill a mug and then quickly cover it up to keep it hot for her other sugar addicts that were still upstairs. Lily slid off the counter with her help and led her to their favorite cuddle spot in the entire house, their loveseat with the footrest tucked up against it. Lena let her get comfy before handing the mug to her. She grabbed the softest blanket they had and sat next to her, immediately feeling the little body snuggle into her. A quick flick of the wrist had the blanket wrapped around them. Her arms encircled Lily and her head rested on her chest. “Hope, please turn on the fireplace.” The AI wordlessly ignited their fireplace and had the chill quickly leaving the room. Her legs crossed at the ankle under the blanket while her hand started carding through Lily’s hair again. “Are you excited to open your presents?” 

 

“Mhm,” Lily replied sleepily. She smiled and kissed the top of her head, breathing in the strawberry smell of her daughter's shampoo. 

 

“What are you most excited to do on this break from school?” 

 

“This,” she quietly said. 

 

Her blonde curls were so soft to the touch just like Kara’s. It was so clear who her mother was in moments like these where they were cuddling. It wasn’t often that Lily wanted a cuddle with either her or Kara though. She could always be found with one of her siblings cuddling her, but not usually her mom’s. She cherished every moment that Lily wanted to be with them because she knew they were going to get smaller and smaller as she got older. The necklace she had given Lily years ago was worn around her neck every single day. It was a reminder to her that Lily chose her everyday. 

 

“This is my favorite thing to do too. Spending time with everyone that I love so much.” 

 

Lily snuggled in closer, her hand gripped onto the front of her shirt in a small fist. “What were your Christmases like growing up?” 

 

Lena rested her cheek on top of Lily’s head, “They weren’t anything like what we do. There were a lot of big parties that I had to go to with my parents. I’d have to wear itchy dresses and shoes that pinched my toes. Most of the time I would just be stuck sitting at a table with the nanny and my brother all night. My mom and dad wouldn’t really include us in anything. They just wanted us to be there for pictures.” 

 

“Did you at least get to open presents on Christmas morning?” 

 

Lena moved the hand that was in her hair to her back and started rubbing gently. “A few. Lex would get me a present or two. But my parents never had time to spend with us. Christmas wasn’t really magical or that fun growing up. Not how it is now. When your mom and I were just friends she invited me to her apartment for Christmas. That was the first year I really got to see how magical it could be. Everything was so warm and cozy, I was so happy. We had lots of food, and a bunch of our friends were there. It was wonderful.” 

 

Lily turned to look up at her, forcing her to lift her own head. “I’m sorry your parents weren’t great. I’m glad mom could make Christmas special for you. You deserve all the happy Christmases.” 

 

Lena kissed the tip of her nose, “Every year has been so magical and special with our family. I have never been happier than I am with your mom, your sister, your brother and you.” 

 

Lily smiled up at her and then kissed her cheek. “I love you.” 

 

“I love you too, so much.” She gave her another little squeeze just as her ears registered the sound of footsteps on the stairs again. 

 

Kara came into view with Alexis on one hip and Liam on the other and Krypto following behind. All three were wearing matching plaid, long john style pajamas. Of course she and Lily were also wearing the matching pajamas too. She secretly loved that matching pajamas were a tradition in their house. “There they are,” Kara said as she made her way over to the loveseat. 

 

“We haven’t been hiding, we’re just snuggling,” Lily said. 

 

Kara pretended to look offended, “Why weren’t we invited to snuggle?” 

 

“Because Liam and Lex kick too much when we snuggle. So I came down to snuggle with mummy by myself,” Lily replied and stuck her tongue out to tease Kara. 

 

Lena gave her a little squeeze, “She’s right, love. You guys do tend to snuggle like a little pack of wolves.” 

 

Kara set Alexis down and she immediately headed over to the pile of presents under the tree. Lily quickly scrambled off her lap to join her sister on the floor, “Can we open presents now?” Lily took Liam from her arms and sat down with him in her lap, his back to her chest. Alexis started pulling presents out from under the tree as fast as her little hands could move. Krypto took his usual spot next to Lily and rested his head right next to her leg. 

 

Kara plopped down next to Lena where Lily had been sitting, “Yes you guys can start opening presents.” Her arm settled around Lena’s shoulders and she found herself leaning into Kara’s warmth immediately. She sighed happily as she snuggled in further to her wife. Her hand rested on Kara’s stomach while her head found its place on her shoulder. Kara kissed her cheek, “I love you.” 

 

Lena turned to kiss her properly. “I love you more.” 

 

Alexis was bringing presents to Lily and asking her to read the names on them. Then she would put them in one of five piles that were starting to grow around her. Lena smiled at the sight of the three of them in their matching pajamas. Kara gave her shoulder a squeeze, “They’re kinda cute.” 

 

“They really are. I think we should keep them for another year at least.” 

 

Kara laughed, “Yea, another year at least. Till we have teenagers maybe. Then we can reconsider.” 

 

“I think Lily will be fine as a teenager, now Alexis on the other hand. That little one might give us a run for our money.” 

 

“Good thing we have a lot of it,” Kara teased. 

 

The piles on the floor continued to grow until three were significantly larger than the other two. Alexis ran over and grabbed her hand, “Can we open now mumma!?” 

 

Lena pulled her up across their laps and covered her face in kisses, “Don’t you want to cuddle first? You didn’t even say good morning!” 

 

Alexis giggled and squirmed to try and get out of her grasp. “Good morningggggg. Merry Christmas! No more kisses!” 

 

Lena started tickling her sides while continuing her attack of kisses. “Merry Christmas my little darling.” Alexis started wiggling around and giggled harder under the fingers mercilessly attacking her sides. Kara was laughing next to her watching the two of them. 

 

“Mumma presentsssss! Stopppppp!”  

 

She stopped tickling her to let her catch her breath. Lena kissed her forehead, “Oh fine. You can open presents now.” 

 

Alexis slid off her lap but caught her hand and tugged. “Come sit with me?” 

 

Lena couldn’t help but smile at the request. Lillian would never have been caught dead sitting on the floor with her or Lex on Christmas morning. “Of course. Mommy and I will come down and open presents with you guys.” She slid off the chair and down onto the floor with her kids. Alexis immediately climbed into her lap and smiled up at her. She wrapped her arms around her daughter and gave her a little squeeze. A blanket was draped around her shoulders as Kara settled next to them on the floor. “Thanks love.” 

 

“Of course,” Kara replied. “Ok kiddos, should we just have a free for all? Let everyone open at once? Or should we go one at a time?” 

 

Lily was the one to answer, “I think we should go one at a time.” Alexis nodded her head in agreement (because she always did what her big sister did). 

 

“Alright, who wants to go first?” 

 

Lily lifted Liam’s hand for him, “Oh look, Liam wants to go first. It’s only fair since it’s his first christmas.” Lena couldn’t help but smile at the generosity that was 100% from the way Kara had raised her. Of course they had gone pretty simple for Liam’s gifts with a small amount of toys, some pajamas that matched his sisters, and some baby snack puffs. Kara handed over the first small gift for Liam to open. 

 

“You girls might have to help him and show him how it’s done,” Kara said. Lily helped put his hands on the present but all he did was yawn in response. Lena couldn’t help but laugh quietly at her little boy. Kara pulled one side of the wrapping paper open to try and entice Liam but all he did was gently pat it. Lily pulled paper from the other side until he could see what was inside. His eyes lit up at the sight of a teething giraffe. He loved any type of animal so that was what they had stuck with for him. Little hands pulled at the giraffe and immediately it went into his mouth. She was infinitely thankful that her perpetual worrying had led her to washing all of the toys that could possibly make it into Liam’s mouth before wrapping them. 

 

Liam snuggled back against Lily while happily chewing on the giraffe. “Ok girls, one of you can go next.” Alexis grabbed a box that was decorated with a big blue bow on top. Her little fingers quickly tore the paper from it.

 

“Momma look!” Alexis exclaimed as she held up a Wonder Woman doll. Bless her wife, she took it like a good sport and looked excitedly at their daughter and put her own feelings aside.

 

“Baby that’s so cool!” Kara exclaimed. 

 

Alexis hopped over to Kara and held the box out to her, “Open it please!” 

 

Lena looked over sympathetically at her favorite superhero as she took the doll out of the box and passed it to their daughter. To her credit she did look genuinely happy that Alexis was so excited. Their little girl hugged the doll tight in her arms. “Mummy look!” 

 

“I see baby, that’s so awesome. I think it’s safe to say you like it.” 

 

Little arms wrapped around Kara’s neck as Alexis squeezed her. “Thank you thank you thank you momma!” Kara resounded with a chuckle and hugging her little body close. 

 

“You’re welcome sweetheart.” 

 

Lena got a kiss on the cheek and an equally excited, “Thank you mummy!” Alexis settled down in Kara’s lap with her doll held tight in her arms. It was quite a sight to see Supergirl holding her daughter, who was clutching a Wonder Woman doll. 

 

Lena reached over and slid a present to Lily, “Open that one first darling.” She took Liam from her arms so she could open her presents more easily. Lily was the more methodical one of their children as she carefully pulled the paper off her gift. Instantly her eyes lit up seeing the Mandalorian Lego set they’d gotten for her. 

 

“Thank you!” She set the Lego set down and crawled over to hug both of them. 

 

“You’re welcome honey,” Lena replied. 

 

“You’re welcome baby,” Kara said with a kiss to her cheek. 

 

Their morning continued the same way with everyone opening presents. Kara was helping Alexis assemble the gates of Jurassic Park with her box of lego blocks. Lily was looking at different things under her microscope that they’d gifted her (a kids one, despite Lena trying to get her a more advanced one). And Liam was snuggled in her arms back on the loveseat as he ate a bottle. His blue eyes bore into hers as he gave her a dimpled smile. “Merry Christmas my little love,” she whispered. Her lips gently pressed a soft kiss to his forehead that had his eyes closing and snuggling further into her arms. Alexis put the last block on the top of the gates and her arms were thrown in the air, “We did it!” Kara pulled her close with a laugh. 

 

“It looks great baby! You did almost all of it by yourself too!” 

 

Alexis turned to face her, “Mumma did you see!? It’s the dino doors!” 

 

“It looks just like the movie baby, I’m so proud of you!” 

 

Alexis beamed at her and then turned to face her older sister. She was always seeking the approval of her older sister, naturally. And, being the great older sister she was, Lily dropped what she was doing to start playing with Alexis. “This is so cool Lex!” 

 

Kara appeared at her side again, stealing half the blankets as she snuggled up. The first thing she did was kiss his little head and then her cheek. Lena smiled over at her, “I love you darling.” 

 

“I love you too, babe.” 

 

“I truly never thought holidays could be this happy. I thought it was all fake in the movies. I thought families just went about their days like normal after opening a few presents. I truly did not know that not all adults had to work through the holidays like Lillian and Lionel did. It wasn’t until we became friends that I got to experience Christmas for the magical holiday it could be. And seeing Christmas through our kids' eyes is something I never even dreamed. Thank you. For giving me what I never knew I always wanted.” 

 

Kara’s arm slipped around her shoulders and guided her closer. Their lips met in a soft kiss that had her melting into her wife’s embrace. “You’ve given me everything I dreamed of and more. I’m glad that our holidays are filled with laughter and smiles. Our kids will always think of holidays as times of joy and happiness. I can’t believe how big they are but I also can’t wait to see what the future holds.” 

 

She handed over Liam’s empty bottle to Kara and adjusted him up onto her shoulder. Her hand lightly patted his back until all the air was out of his little body. “I think the future is going to be incredible. As long as you’re by my side, I know that it’ll be better than I ever thought.” 

 

Kara kissed her cheek again, “Merry Christmas babe.” 

 

“Merry Christmas love.”
